issues.title: DashScope provider is not selected for Model Studio workspace-dedicated domains (*.maas.aliyuncs.com)

labels.name: status/needs-triage
labels.description: Issue needs to be triaged and labeled

labels.name: type/bug
labels.description: Something isn't working as expected

issues.body:
### What happened?

When the OpenAI-compatible base URL is a Model Studio (Bailian) **workspace-dedicated domain**, for example `https://llm-xxx.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`, Qwen Code does not select the DashScope provider. Requests go through the generic OpenAI-compatible provider instead, so none of the DashScope-specific request shaping applies:

- no `cache_control` markers, so explicit context cache is never used and only implicit caching applies
- no `X-DashScope-CacheControl` / `X-DashScope-UserAgent` / `X-DashScope-AuthType` headers
- no DashScope handling of `enable_thinking` / `thinking_budget` / tiered effort, no GLM plain-text flattening, no vision parameters or request metadata

Cause: `DashScopeOpenAICompatibleProvider.isDashScopeProvider()` (`packages/core/src/core/openaiContentGenerator/provider/dashscope.ts:198`) only accepts:

- `DASHSCOPE_REGIONAL_HOSTS` (`dashscope.aliyuncs.com`, `dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com`, `dashscope-us.aliyuncs.com`)
- `token-plan.*.maas.aliyuncs.com`
- `*.alibaba-inc.com`, `*.aliyun-inc.com`, `*.alicloudapi.com`
- the `DASHSCOPE_PROXY_BASE_URL` match

`{WorkspaceId}.{region}.maas.aliyuncs.com` matches none of these.

This domain is the one Model Studio recommends today. Its [regions and endpoints page](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/regions/) lists the workspace-dedicated domain as recommended for production. It describes `dashscope.aliyuncs.com` as legacy compatibility, with a note that it gets no new features after 2026-09-30. Migrating only requires swapping the host, and the same API paths (for example `/compatible-mode/v1` and `/api/v1`) are served. Users who follow that guidance therefore silently lose the DashScope provider.

The codebase is inconsistent on this point. Other paths already treat every `*.maas.aliyuncs.com` host as Model Studio:

- `packages/cli/src/serve/live/provider-credentials.ts:93`
- `packages/core/src/telemetry/gen-ai-provider.ts:53`

Only the chat provider selection excludes it.

### What did you expect to happen?

A `*.maas.aliyuncs.com` base URL is detected as DashScope, the same way `token-plan.*.maas.aliyuncs.com` already is. This covers the workspace-dedicated `{WorkspaceId}.{region}.maas.aliyuncs.com` hosts and also `trial.{region}.maas.aliyuncs.com`.

The endpoint behaves as DashScope. Measured against a workspace-dedicated cn-beijing endpoint with `qwen3.8-max`:

- `cache_control: {type: 'ephemeral'}` is honored. A repeated request returns `prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens = 11947 / 11955`, together with `cache_type: 'ephemeral'`, `cache_creation_input_tokens` and `cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens`. These are the DashScope explicit-cache usage fields.
- `enable_thinking` is accepted, and so are the `X-DashScope-*` headers (HTTP 200).
- Errors use the DashScope shape (`request_id`, `code: "InvalidParameter"`, with a link to the model-studio error-code page).

### Client information

<details>
<summary>Client Information</summary>

Found by reading source on `upstream/main` at `1fb9c8313e` (package version 0.25.1), Linux. The behavior follows from the provider selection code above, so it does not depend on the client environment.

</details>

### Login information

API Config (`security.auth.selectedType: openai`). `modelProviders.openai[]` entry with `baseUrl: https://llm-xxx.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1` (workspace ID redacted), `wireApi: chat-completions`, and the key passed through `envKey`.

### Anything else we need to know?

**Possible fix.** Accept any `*.maas.aliyuncs.com` hostname in `isDashScopeProvider()`, replacing the `token-plan.` prefix check. Add tests for a workspace host and a trial host.

**Cache behavior changes once this is fixed.** Today these users rely on implicit caching. In a probe, implicit caching also reused the tools plus the static system prompt across two sessions whose git status differed: 11264 of 11968 tokens cached. With the current DashScope request shape, the whole system message carries a single marker, and that marker sits after the per-session git status. So cross-session reuse drops to 0, while in-session hits become guaranteed. Two more findings from the same probe:

- `cache_control` on a tool definition is ignored, matching the [context cache docs](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/context-cache).
- Only a marker at the end of a message creates a cache entry. A marker on a non-final content block of the same message does not.

I will open a separate issue for the DashScope cache layout: move the git status out of the system message, and drop the tool marker. This issue is only about provider detection. The two changes are best landed together, or the layout change first.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

百炼业务空间专属域名 `{WorkspaceId}.{region}.maas.aliyuncs.com` 是官方现在推荐的生产接入方式。官方说明 `dashscope.aliyuncs.com` 只做存量兼容，2026-09-30 起不再支持新特性。

但 `isDashScopeProvider()` 只认 `dashscope*.aliyuncs.com` 和 `token-plan.*.maas.aliyuncs.com`，所以用专属域名的用户会落到通用 OpenAI 兼容 provider。显式缓存 `cache_control`、`X-DashScope-*` 请求头、thinking/effort 参数映射等 DashScope 专有逻辑全部失效。

实测专属域名的行为与 DashScope 一致：`cache_control` 生效，usage 字段相同，`enable_thinking` 与 `X-DashScope-*` 请求头均可用。

建议把识别范围扩大到 `*.maas.aliyuncs.com`。注意，修复后缓存行为会从隐式变成显式：会话内命中有保证，但按当前写法，跨会话复用会从约 94% 降为 0。缓存布局的改进另开 issue，最好与本修复一起合入，或者先于本修复合入。

</details>

issues.title: record_artifact tells the model to use the Artifact tool when that tool is not registered

labels.name: priority/P3
labels.description: Low - Minor, cosmetic, nice-to-fix issues

labels.name: type/bug
labels.description: Something isn't working as expected

labels.name: category/tools
labels.description: Tool integration and execution

issues.body:
### What would you like to be added?

Move the "use the Artifact tool" guidance out of the `record_artifact` tool description, so the model only sees it when the `artifact` tool is registered.

The static `DESCRIPTION` in `packages/core/src/tools/record-artifact.ts` says:

> Use the Artifact tool, not record_artifact, for published interactive HTML artifacts.

`record_artifact` is often registered without `artifact`:

- `isArtifactEnabled()` returns false under a shell execution sandbox, and in non-interactive runs without snapshots (`!interactive && !isArtifactSnapshotsEnabled()`). `isRecordArtifactEnabled()` has neither gate.
- A whole-tool rule removes only `artifact`: `permissions.deny: ["artifact"]`, `tools.exclude`, `--exclude-tools artifact`, or `tools.disabled: ["artifact"]`. `registerLazyTool()` asks `PermissionManager.getToolRegistrationStatus()`, which returns `disabled` for a deny rule without a specifier, and `ToolRegistry.registerFactory()` skips names in `disabledTools`.
- A `tools.core` allowlist that leaves out `artifact`.

In each case the description points the model at a tool it does not have.

Proposed change:

- Remove that sentence from the `record_artifact` description.
- Add the same guidance to the `artifact` tool description ("Use this tool, not record_artifact, for published interactive HTML artifacts."), so it ships only with the tool it refers to.
- No change to `isArtifactEnabled()`, `isRecordArtifactEnabled()`, settings, or environment variables.

### Why is this needed?

Some embedded hosts can open workspace files but cannot open `storage: published` `file://` results. They need to keep `record_artifact` and `write_file` workspace registration and drop the publish tool. That already works with `permissions.deny: ["artifact"]`.

What remains is the `record_artifact` description. With `artifact` unregistered, it still tells the model to use `artifact` for interactive HTML, so the model may try a tool that does not exist before it falls back to writing a workspace file.

### Additional context

- An earlier version of this issue proposed `QWEN_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT_PUBLISH=1`. That proposal is withdrawn, because a whole-tool deny already removes only the publish tool (see `permission-manager.test.ts`, "deny via display name removes the tool from the registry").
- Tests: the `record_artifact` description no longer mentions the Artifact tool, and the `artifact` description carries the guidance. Update tool declaration snapshots if any change.
- Docs (optional): the `experimental.artifact` entry in `settingsSchema.ts` and `docs/users/configuration/settings.md` only describes disabling both tools. It could add that `permissions.deny: ["artifact"]` removes only the publish tool.
- Related: the JSDoc on `disabledTools` in `packages/core/src/config/config.ts` says `permissions.deny` "keeps the tool registered and rejects invocation". A deny rule without a specifier removes the tool at registration, so that comment is worth correcting.

issues.title: ci(sdk-java): a migration in the retired db/migration directory passes both Flyway checks but is never applied

labels.description: Continuous integration/deployment

labels.description: Specified but requires human judgment to implement; not suitable for an autonomous agent

issues.body:
## What happened?

Since #14069 (merged 2026-10-14), the Managed Agent schema lives in `db/managed-schema`, and that is the only location Flyway scans at runtime:

- [`managed-agent-server/src/main/resources/application.yml:15`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6d61d2e78a771062b54d5fa230bbbf7591bcdcf5/packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server/src/main/resources/application.yml#L15) sets `locations: 'classpath:db/managed-schema'`.
- [`ManagedSchema.java:15`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6d61d2e78a771062b54d5fa230bbbf7591bcdcf5/packages/sdk-java/runtime-broker/src/main/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/runtimebroker/managedschema/ManagedSchema.java#L15) sets `FLYWAY_LOCATION = "classpath:db/managed-schema"`.

The old migrations were moved to `docs/archive/managed-agent-schema`, which the consolidation design says is kept "outside runtime/test classpaths" (`docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-schema-consolidation.md`, line 82). `db/migration` is now empty on `main`.

The two Flyway checks still treat the retired directories as live. [`scripts/flyway-migration-utils.js:22-26`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6d61d2e78a771062b54d5fa230bbbf7591bcdcf5/scripts/flyway-migration-utils.js#L22-L26) registers three `LOCATIONS`:

- `src/main/resources/db/migration` (`.sql`)
- `src/main/java/db/migration` (`.java`)
- `src/main/resources/db/managed-schema` (`.sql`)

Both checks count a file in either retired directory as a valid migration:

- `check-flyway-migrations.js`, which runs on each PR
- `check-flyway-open-prs.js`, the latest-main status

So a PR can add `V3__x.sql` under `db/migration`, pass both checks and merge. The migration is then never applied, and Flyway logs nothing about it.

Before #14069 the out-of-place probe blocked this: a migration-shaped file anywhere except the scanned location failed the job. Registering a directory Flyway no longer scans switches that probe off for it.

**Reproduced against `main` `6d61d2e78a`.** Every case starts from `main`'s layout, where `runtime-broker/src/main/resources/db/managed-schema/` holds V1 and V2:

| Case | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `check-flyway-migrations.js`, plus `runtime-broker/src/main/resources/db/migration/V3__legacy_dir.sql` | exit 0, `runtime-broker: 3 migrations, all versions unique` |
| `check-flyway-migrations.js`, plus `managed-agent-server/src/main/java/db/migration/V4__legacy_java.java` | exit 0, `managed-agent-server: 1 migrations, all versions unique` |
| `check-flyway-open-prs.js` `run()` (dry run, stubbed `gh`), with three open PRs: one adding each file above, and one adding `managed-schema/V5__right_dir.sql` | all three PRs get `success: No collision with main` |
| Flyway 11.7.2 + H2 2.4.240 with `locations("classpath:db/managed-schema")`. The classpath holds V1, V2, the SQL V3 and the compiled Java V4 (a `BaseJavaMigration`) | `Successfully validated 2 migrations`. It applies V1 and V2 with no warning, and V3 and V4 never appear in `info()` |
| Control: the same classpath with `locations("classpath:db/migration")` | applies V3 and V4, so both files are valid migrations |

**The guard's own error message points into the trap.** A stray migration elsewhere still fails, which is correct. But the message names the retired directory, because it reports the first registered location under that source root ([`check-flyway-migrations.js:157`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6d61d2e78a771062b54d5fa230bbbf7591bcdcf5/scripts/check-flyway-migrations.js#L157)). Here is the output with `main`'s layout plus a file in a mistyped directory, `runtime-broker/src/main/resources/db/managed-schema-new/V3__typo_dir.sql`:

```
::error::packages/sdk-java/runtime-broker: found no migration under src/main/resources/db/migration; if it moved, point this check at the new location: packages/sdk-java/runtime-broker/src/main/resources/db/managed-schema-new/V3__typo_dir.sql
```

If a contributor follows this message and moves the file into `db/migration`, the check passes and the migration silently never runs.

**Who can hit it.** Nothing on `main` or in an open PR does today. The latest re-check (2026-10-15 01:52 UTC) sees only #13325 and #13526, and both add files under `db/managed-schema`. Two groups are exposed:

- PRs branched before #14069 that add a migration in the old place. A new file in a directory deleted on `main` merges without a conflict.
- Anyone following the older descriptions, which still name the old location:
  - `docs/design/2026-09-20-managed-agent-storage-event-architecture.md:39`
  - the comment at `.github/workflows/sdk-java.yml:252`: "Flyway resolves classpath:db/migration across the jars"

## What did you expect to happen?

The checks register exactly the locations Flyway scans, so a migration placed anywhere else fails before merge.

Suggested change, for maintainers to decide:

1. **`scripts/flyway-migration-utils.js`.** Keep only `src/main/resources/db/managed-schema` (`.sql`) in `LOCATIONS`. The existing out-of-place probe then fails any `V<n>__*.sql` under `db/migration`, and its message names `db/managed-schema`.
   - Removing the `.java` entry must not remove the probe of `src/main/java`. Today the probe roots come from `LOCATIONS`. No Java location is scanned any more, so any `V<n>__*.java` under `src/main/java` should fail.
   - If Java migrations are needed later, their location has to be added to Flyway's `locations` and to `LOCATIONS` in the same change. `classpath:db/managed-schema` cannot hold them, because `db.managed-schema` is not a legal Java package name.
2. **Pin the agreement.** Add a test in `scripts/tests` that reads `spring.flyway.locations` from `application.yml` and `ManagedSchema.FLYWAY_LOCATION`, and asserts that they match `LOCATIONS`. Then the next move of the schema cannot leave the checks behind.
3. **Remove the stale references.**
   - The `sdk-java.yml:252` comment.
   - The `db/migration` push paths in `sdk-java-flyway-open-prs.yml` (lines 20–21).
   - The `db/migration` fixtures in `.github/scripts/ci/main-failure-signature.test.mjs`, if the error text changes. Its signature regex already accepts any path.

#13954 (Flyway ordering, for #13922) edits the same helpers (`isMigrationPath`, and the `LOCATIONS` use in `check-flyway-open-prs.js`). Whichever lands second has to merge the other in.

## Client information

Not client-specific. Repository CI checked at `main` `6d61d2e78a`:
- `scripts/flyway-migration-utils.js`
- `scripts/check-flyway-migrations.js`
- `scripts/check-flyway-open-prs.js`
- `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server/src/main/resources/application.yml`
- `packages/sdk-java/runtime-broker/src/main/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/runtimebroker/managedschema/ManagedSchema.java`

## Login information

N/A

## Anything else we need to know?

Found while checking how #13770 (for #13742) behaves after merge. Related: #13922 and #13954.

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): publish an experimental reference distribution
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR adds an experimental Hosted Managed Agent reference distribution that operators can build and verify independently from the npm CLI release. The archive contains the Java control plane, operator-recovery utility, embedded Runtime Broker, package-relative launchers, deployment and recovery guidance, an exact-source manifest, and both detached and in-bundle SHA-256 checksums. A dedicated workflow builds the archive on Linux, boots the exact extracted server against MySQL 8.4, and publishes immutable prerelease assets only from a protected main-branch environment.

The manifest records the Qwen Code and Hosted Harness profile, Serve/Broker/public API versions, Java and Node requirements, Flyway range, supported topology, and the safety defaults for Public Shell and lifecycle v2 advertisement. Packaging fails closed when those defaults are missing, ambiguous, or enabled.

## Why it's needed

The Hosted implementation already has Java control-plane, recovery, and Runtime Broker artifacts, but there was no supported operator-consumable bundle tying those components to one source revision and compatibility contract. That gap made a local build difficult to reproduce and left no guarded path from a verified candidate to an experimental Hosted prerelease.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the reference-distribution workflow for this PR or as a manual dry run. Confirm that it builds two byte-identical candidates, verifies the detached and in-bundle checksums, reports the pull-request head in the manifest, and boots the server from the extracted archive against MySQL 8.4. Inspect the manifest and confirm that Public Shell and lifecycle v2 advertisement remain disabled, the topology is one Java control plane on a trusted Linux host, and the database migration range matches the bundled server. Production publication should remain unavailable outside the protected main-branch environment and should publish only after the exact tag and uploaded assets have been verified.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: no supported command or workflow produced a versioned Hosted reference distribution.

After: one deterministic archive carries the three matching Java artifacts, relative launchers, operator documentation, provenance, compatibility metadata, and independently verifiable checksums. Detailed local E2E evidence is posted in a separate PR comment.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS local packaging and process verification used Java 21, Node 22, native MySQL 8.4.11, and the exact committed-head archive. Linux with MySQL 8.4 is the required CI environment and remains pending until this branch is pushed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the artifact is explicitly experimental and supports one Java control plane with an embedded Runtime Broker on a trusted Linux host.
- Not validated / out of scope: multi-control-plane deployment, physical Kubernetes/CSI failure recovery, MariaDB compatibility, automatic stable releases, Public Shell, and lifecycle v2 advertisement.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; this distribution is separate from the npm CLI release and production publication is opt-in through a protected environment.
- Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-14-managed-agent-reference-distribution.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-14-managed-agent-reference-distribution.zh-CN.md)

Resolves #14157

Related to #12380

prs.title: docs(runtime-broker): design Workspace-resident Managed Tool Runtime
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the bilingual design (PR0 of #14211) for a Workspace-resident Managed Tool Runtime. Today a Workspace-bound Hosted Session must use a Session-isolated local worker, so every Session starts its own worker, nothing warms a worker ahead of demand, and nothing reclaims an idle one. The design makes the Tool Runtime resident per `(tenant, storage)` without changing the invariant that one worker process is one binding generation:

- Workspace-bound Sessions may opt into Workspace isolation, so every Session on one storage shares one durable worker generation. Storage holders keep serializing tool turns as they do today.
- Session close splits into releasing the closing Session's Runtime Sessions through the original worker and a separate binding-level retirement, so closing one Session never stops a worker other Sessions use. The close-evidence trade-off this implies is called out as an explicit decision.
- Prewarm adds a Session-create warm and an operator keep-warm list, both placement-only.
- Idle retirement and generation recycle reuse the existing drain, stop and drain-receipt path. They serialize with Runtime Session admission, and turn today's non-retryable placement refusal during an idle drain into a retryable one.
- Capability-type `"local-process"` literal checks become provisioner capabilities, with no behaviour change.

It also records the delivery split (PR1 capabilities, PR2 Workspace isolation, PR3 prewarm and PR4 idle retirement, the last two in parallel), failure semantics, validation and acceptance criteria, and four open questions. No code changes.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-15-managed-workspace-resident-runtime.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-15-managed-workspace-resident-runtime.zh-CN.md)

## Why it's needed

Without Workspace residency, every bound Session pays its own worker start, and an unclosed Session keeps an idle worker forever: the server README asks operators to budget that growth. The implementation slices change isolation, close and placement semantics that earlier reliable-close and W0e work validated, so the boundaries need agreement before code lands.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Check the "Current state" table against `main` @ `355ac8032d`. Each row cites the code it summarizes, notably:
  - Session close only enumerates Session-isolated bindings;
  - `stopDrained` and its admission checks require Session isolation;
  - a `DRAINING` binding blocks placement on the same storage with a non-retryable error.
- Review the decisions in sections 4.2 and 4.4, especially open question 1: should the activation-release acknowledgement count as reliable-close evidence for Workspace-isolated Sessions?
- Confirm both language versions have the same structure, decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria and follow-up work.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (documentation only).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A. Prettier check passed on both files. Headings, list items and code identifiers were compared between the two versions.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the proposed Workspace-isolated close relies on worker-attested release instead of worker process death; it is opt-in and Session isolation stays the default.
- Not validated / out of scope: no implementation or measurement. TTL, recycle and keep-warm defaults are left to deployment measurement. Remote/SSH placement and a registered resident worker replacing `static` are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Part of #14211. Related: #12380.

prs.title: diagnostics(ci): capture RocketMQ latency stages separately
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Collect per-publication hub and transport timings, per-round wall/CPU samples, and JFR execution, lock-wait and GC evidence in a separate diagnostic burst. The existing latency gate runs first with recording disabled, its original measurement code, and main's existing 1 ms local / 20 ms CI allowance. Production timing remains disabled unless a recording explicitly enables it.

## Why it's needed

The failure in #14178 recorded aggregate percentiles, which cannot distinguish publication cost from subscriber reads, lock contention or scheduling. This follow-up makes the segmented evidence available without mixing recording overhead into the gate's asserted measurements. It does not claim to fix the RocketMQ latency root cause.

SDK Java runs daily or by manual dispatch; this PR does not restore per-PR Java execution. To collect evidence before merging, a maintainer must manually dispatch SDK Java against `codex/rocketmq-latency-evidence`. No workflow was dispatched as part of this repair.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Manually select this branch for SDK Java if pre-merge evidence is needed. The RocketMQ broker job should run the unchanged 300-round latency gate first, then a separate 300-round diagnostic burst with JFR enabled. A gate failure should remain the reported failure even if diagnostics also fail.

The report artifact should contain the original uninstrumented `event-transport-latency.json`, a separate `event-transport-latency-diagnostics.json`, raw samples, production-stage records and the JFR recording. Session, sequence, thread and transport count should connect instrumented publications to their lock/execution evidence. Warm-up samples remain available. Diagnostic measurements must not be used in the latency assertions.

Confirm that normal publication still reaches the hub before transports, propagates hub failures and isolates transport runtime failures. Without an explicitly enabled recording, publication should not allocate timing objects or read the clock.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no UI changes. Existing failure evidence: [RocketMQ gate run](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/38570284735/job/115873911795). Review identified an incorrect claim about PR-triggered execution and recording overhead inside the asserted burst; this revision corrects both and restores main's gate allowance. Static inspection only: no local tests, builds or lint checks, no workflow dispatch, and no CI monitoring or waiting.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not run, per request |
| Windows | Not run, per request |
| Linux | Not run locally; CI not monitored |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — broker diagnostics; real broker execution is pending.

## Risk & Scope

- The extra diagnostic burst adds broker work and recording overhead. Its numbers are diagnostic evidence, not uninstrumented performance claims.
- The gate retains main's original workload and latency limits. Diagnostic failures remain visible, but cannot replace an existing gate failure.
- Root-cause repair and actual artifact verification remain pending new evidence. Daily/manual triggers, schema and publication-delivery contracts are unchanged.
- Design notes: [English](docs/design/2026-10-12-managed-agent-event-transport-mq2.md) / [中文](docs/design/2026-10-12-managed-agent-event-transport-mq2.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #14178.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 修改内容

在独立诊断轮次中采集每次 hub 与 transport 发布分段耗时、逐轮墙钟/CPU 样本，以及 JFR 执行栈、锁等待和 GC 证据。先运行既有延迟门禁，期间不开启 recording，保留原测量代码和 main 现有的本地 1 ms、CI 20 ms 容差。只有 recording 显式启用时才开启生产计时。

### 修改原因

#14178 的失败只有聚合 p95，无法区分发布、订阅读取、锁竞争或调度成本。本后续 PR 提供分段证据，并将 recording 开销与门禁断言的测量窗口分开，不声称已修复 RocketMQ 延迟根因。

SDK Java 仅每日运行或手动触发，本 PR 不恢复逐 PR 的 Java 执行。若需合并前采证，维护者须手动选择 `codex/rocketmq-latency-evidence` 分支运行 SDK Java。本轮修复没有触发 workflow。

### Reviewer Test Plan

**How to verify：** 如需合并前证据，手动选择此分支运行 SDK Java。RocketMQ job 应先执行原有 300 轮延迟门禁，再单独执行启用 JFR 的 300 轮诊断。即使诊断也失败，已有门禁失败仍应作为原始错误报告。

artifact 应包含无 recording 的原聚合报告 `event-transport-latency.json`、独立的 `event-transport-latency-diagnostics.json`、逐轮样本、生产分段记录和 JFR。通过 Session、序号、线程及 transport 数量关联带采样的发布与锁等待/执行证据，保留预热样本。诊断数字不参与延迟断言。

正常发布仍应先到 hub 再到 transports，传播 hub 异常并隔离 transport 运行时异常。未显式启用 recording 时，不分配计时对象或读取时钟。

**Evidence (Before & After)：** 无 UI 变化。失败证据见上方 RocketMQ run 链接。review 指出了自动触发 PR CI 的错误描述及采证污染门禁测量的问题；本轮修复两者并恢复 main 门槛。仅静态检查，没有运行本地测试、构建或 lint 检查，没有手动触发 workflow，也未监听或等待 CI。

### 风险与范围

prs.title: fix(core): retain CSI preparation resources through the HTTP store
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Private CSI file preparation now commits its input, tool declaration and intent resources through the HTTP store. The predecessor history stays owned by its original journal transaction. An integration gate exercises SQL-issued authorization, authenticated native readback, actual file tools and two retained-history continuations under the same original writer and activation.

## Why it's needed

The first live MySQL run refused preparation because its same-transaction resource set omitted nested admission references. Component tests had not exercised that HTTP closure through SQL dispatch and the actual worker. This fixes the missing references while preserving SQL's exact candidate census, and makes the complete SQL/HTTP/file chain reproducible.

This follows merged #13996. It targets main. The canonical-V2 baseline witness expectation previously proposed in #14174 is not a contribution of this PR: main landed the identical one-line flip in `31e02ace613` (#14177), so `BackfillWitnessesTest.java` does not appear in this diff and the carried commit `9979aa31d309` is a no-op against current main. #14174 is superseded and closed, with no separate prerequisite. The six-path implementation commit is `fe36524c395b83d5453d201d616c30a38e5ca69c`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Confirm that private prepared history includes exactly its current preparation dependencies, excludes predecessor metadata, and leaves ordinary history behavior intact. Confirm that production dispatch creates four immutable SQL grants, the authenticated worker executes read/write/read/edit across two inputs, retries preserve grants and effects, owner resource reads finish with durable RETURNED receipts, and the original activation survives both continuations.

Wrong token, lease, owner, context and ungranted-execution probes must refuse before further file effects. After write then edit, retained history must contain the original `alpha` and intermediate `beta`, while the working file contains `gamma`. All owned listeners, child processes, files and the isolated database must be removed.

### How to verify

Build the Node workspaces before invoking the internal MySQL gate. From the Core package, run `npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.test.ts`. From the Managed Agent Server package with current SDK/Broker dependencies installed, invoke `mvn -Dtest=WorkspaceCsiSqlWorkerMySqlIT -Dmysql.url=<owned-admin-catalog-url> -Dmysql.user=<test-user> test checkstyle:check`. The test creates and drops a separate catalog; use a disposable database account with those permissions. The existing `mysql-integration` profile also discovers this IT after its native producer prerequisite build.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: the independent collector reproduction on unchanged production code returned zero references instead of the three required preparation references; the live MySQL preparation was refused.
- Baseline witness (historical evidence for #14174's proposal, not a change this PR makes): the old assertion was independently reproduced on exact main 4b6b4270d (3 cases: 1 failure, 2 passes) and the one-line correction at 9979aa31d passed all 6 witness/configuration cases, including V1 history/data preservation and exact table-count checks. Main has since landed the same expectation via `31e02ace613` (#14177), so `git diff origin/main HEAD -- packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server/src/test/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/managedagent/BackfillWitnessesTest.java` is empty at the current head.
- After: all 83 Core HTTP-store cases passed. One independent real MySQL integration test passed with zero failures, errors or skips, completing two turns, four actual SQL-authorized tool calls and 32 logical refusal assertions. The 32 assertions are inside one integration test, not 32 JUnit cases.
- Build, typecheck, bundle, targeted Core ESLint, Java Checkstyle and production SpotBugs passed. The final commit tree exactly matches the independently verified staged bytes; unchanged successful Core/build evidence was reused rather than rerun after commit metadata changed. Two complete clean diff audits and independent code review found no actionable issue.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| macOS | Passed with real MySQL and explicit mount/proc-fd, placement and HTTP destination fixtures |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux | CI pending; no local native CSI qualification |

### Environment

Darwin arm64, Node 24.19.0, JDK 21.0.12.1, Maven 3.9.16 and owned MySQL 8.4.11. Independent verification froze source, compiled output and 123 actual Maven dependency jars, and confirmed process, listener, catalog and temporary-directory cleanup.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: the Core resource collector is shared by commit, resource-read and read-only snapshot consumers. The change is limited to private schemaVersion 2 preparation dependencies; ordinary-history controls pass. Maintainer architecture review remains required.
- Qualification limit: placement/protection, mount provenance, Darwin proc-fd addressing and the fixture Pod destination are explicitly mapped. SQL authorization, native HTTP readback, worker authentication, file tools, history composition and replies use production implementations. Scripted native model records drive the internal gate; this is not LLM, Hosted private execution or native CSI/Kubernetes deployment acceptance.
- No schema or migration change: published canonical V1/V2 and 32 business tables remain unchanged. No public selector or new lifecycle, recovery, retirement or release capability is added.
- The observed MariaDB lane on the superseded #14174 failed during schema initialization with `Managed schema generated column differs: ma_session.csi_guard`. That code matches main and is outside these changes; this PR does not claim MariaDB CI is green.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fe36524c395b83d5453d201d616c30a38e5ca69c/docs/design/csi-sql-worker-acceptance.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fe36524c395b83d5453d201d616c30a38e5ca69c/docs/design/csi-sql-worker-acceptance.zh-CN.md). Both versions contain the same decisions, boundaries and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #13996; supersedes #14174, whose baseline correction reaches main through #14177 rather than through this PR. No issue is automatically closed.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

私有 CSI 文件 preparation 通过 HTTP store 提交 input、工具声明和 intent 资源，predecessor history 仍属于其原 journal 事务。新增集成门禁在同一原 writer 与 activation 下，覆盖 SQL 生成授权、认证 native 回读、实际文件工具和两轮 retained-history 续接。

## 为什么需要

首次实时 MySQL 执行因同事务资源集合遗漏嵌套准入引用而拒绝 preparation。已有组件测试没有将 HTTP 资源闭包、SQL dispatch 与真实 worker 连起来。本改动补齐引用，保留 SQL 精确 candidate 校验，并让完整 SQL/HTTP/文件链路可复现。

这是已合并 #13996 的后续。以 main 为 base。先前 #14174 提出的 canonical-V2 baseline witness 期待**不是**本 PR 的贡献：main 已通过 `31e02ace613`（#14177）合入完全相同的一行翻转，因此 `BackfillWitnessesTest.java` 不在本 diff 中，被携带的提交 `9979aa31d309` 相对当前 main 是 no-op。#14174 已被取代并关闭，不再作为单独前置。六个路径的实现提交为 `fe36524c395b83d5453d201d616c30a38e5ca69c`。

## 评审测试计划

确认私有 prepared history 准确包含当前 preparation 依赖、排除 predecessor 元数据，普通 history 行为保持原样。确认生产 dispatch 创建四份不可变 SQL grant，认证 worker 在两次输入间实际执行 read/write/read/edit，重试保持 grant 和文件效果，owner 资源读取完成持久 RETURNED 回执，原 activation 在两轮续接中保持一致。

错误 token、lease、owner、context 和未授权 execution 必须在进一步文件效果前拒绝。write 后 edit，retained history 应保留原 `alpha` 与中间 `beta`，工作文件为 `gamma`。自有 listener、子进程、文件和隔离数据库均须清理。

### 如何验证

先构建 Node workspace，再运行内部 MySQL 门禁。从 Core 包运行 `npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.test.ts`。在安装当前 SDK/Broker 依赖后，从 Managed Agent Server 包执行 `mvn -Dtest=WorkspaceCsiSqlWorkerMySqlIT -Dmysql.url=<owned-admin-catalog-url> -Dmysql.user=<test-user> test checkstyle:check`。测试会创建并删除独立 catalog，应使用具备相应权限的临时数据库账号。既有 `mysql-integration` profile 会在构建 native producer 前置依赖后发现这个 IT。

### 修改前后证据

- 修改前：独立 collector 复现使用未修改的生产代码，期望三项 preparation 引用却得到零项；实时 MySQL preparation 被拒绝。
- baseline witness（#14174 提案的历史证据，不是本 PR 做出的改动）：独立代理在准确主干 4b6b4270d 上复现旧断言（3 项：1 失败、2 通过）；一行修正提交 9979aa31d 的 6 项 witness/configuration 用例全部通过，包含 V1 历史/数据保留与准确表数。main 此后已通过 `31e02ace613`（#14177）合入同样的期待，因此在当前 head 上 `git diff origin/main HEAD -- packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server/src/test/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/managedagent/BackfillWitnessesTest.java` 为空。
- 修改后：83 项 Core HTTP-store 用例通过；独立真实 MySQL 集成测试 1 项通过，无失败、错误或跳过，完成两轮、四次实际 SQL 授权工具调用及 32 项逻辑拒绝断言。32 项断言位于一个集成测试内，不是 32 个 JUnit 用例。
- build、typecheck、bundle、定向 Core ESLint、Java Checkstyle 和生产 SpotBugs 通过。最终提交树准确匹配独立验证过的 staged 字节；仅提交元数据变化后复用未改变的成功 Core/build 证据。两轮完整无问题自审和独立评审未发现可操作问题。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :--- |
| macOS | 真实 MySQL 通过，使用显式 mount/proc-fd、placement 与 HTTP 目标地址 fixture |
| Windows | 未本地测试 |
| Linux | CI 待完成，未进行本地原生 CSI 验收 |

### 环境

Darwin arm64、Node 24.19.0、JDK 21.0.12.1、Maven 3.9.16 和自有 MySQL 8.4.11。独立验证冻结源码、编译输出及 123 个实际 Maven 依赖 JAR，并核对进程、listener、catalog 和临时目录清理。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：Core resource collector 被 commit、resource-read 和只读 snapshot 共享。改动限于私有 schemaVersion 2 preparation 依赖；普通 history 对照通过，仍需维护者架构复审。
- 验收边界：placement/protection、mount 来源、Darwin proc-fd 地址和 fixture Pod 目标地址明确采用映射。SQL 授权、native HTTP 回读、worker 认证、文件工具、history composition 和回复使用生产实现。内部门禁由脚本化 native model 记录驱动，不构成 LLM、Hosted 私有执行或原生 CSI/Kubernetes 部署验收。
- 无 schema 或迁移改动：已发布 canonical V1/V2 与 32 张业务表保持不变。不增加公开 selector 或新的 lifecycle、恢复、退役、release 能力。
- 已被取代的 #14174 所观察 MariaDB lane 在 schema 初始化阶段报 `Managed schema generated column differs: ma_session.csi_guard`。该代码与 main 相同，属于本改动之外的问题；本 PR 不宣称 MariaDB CI 全绿。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fe36524c395b83d5453d201d616c30a38e5ca69c/docs/design/csi-sql-worker-acceptance.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fe36524c395b83d5453d201d616c30a38e5ca69c/docs/design/csi-sql-worker-acceptance.zh-CN.md)。两版决策、边界和验收标准同步。

## 关联事项

后续于 #13996；取代 #14174，其 baseline 修正经 #14177 进入 main，而非经由本 PR。不自动关闭 issue。

</details>

prs.title: test(integration): widen workflow completion reply budgets past loaded-shard stalls (#14191)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR deflakes the interactive E2E suite `saved workflow slash-command completion` by widening the two screen-wait budgets that gate on the model's reply after a workflow completion notification, from 30 seconds to 120 seconds (the `waitForScreen` harness default), with a comment recording why the larger budget exists.

## Why it's needed

Main CI failed once on the `E2E Test (Linux) - sandbox:docker - shard 1/1` leg in `delivers 'WORKFLOW_LARGE_RESULT_12176' once` (#14191). The commit it failed on only touches the Java SDK, so this is a flake rather than a regression. The docker leg runs the whole suite in one shard with three-way fork concurrency on shared hosts, and this repository has already documented that 30-second budgets are too tight there: the cron interactive suite moved its model-turn confirmation to 240 seconds after #10904, and the ready-prompt budget grew to 90 seconds on self-hosted runners after #13552 observed boot stalls past 30 seconds. This test overrode the harness's 120-second default downward to 30 seconds, and the case that failed is the payload-heaviest of the six (a 30,000-character workflow result), i.e. the slowest to settle under load — consistent with a budget flake hitting exactly that case. No production code changes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the diff only widens the two reply-wait budgets in the workflow completion interactive test and that the suite still passes: run `cd integration-tests && QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run interactive/workflow-completion.test.ts` and expect 6/6 passing (takes ~2 minutes). A reviewer can also confirm the failure mode by reading the two waits: both poll for fake-server reply text that only renders after the workflow settles and the notification drains, so a loaded runner can legitimately need longer than 30 seconds.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (test-only timing change, no UI behavior change). Before: main CI docker leg failed once on a 30s reply wait (#14191). After: both reply waits use the 120s harness default; full suite passes locally 6/6 (107s), and a 3-way concurrent load smoke of the previously failing case passed 3/3.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

<!-- ✅ tested · ⚠️ not tested · N/A -->

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux runner, `QWEN_SANDBOX=false` (no Docker daemon available); the sandbox:docker leg itself is covered by CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a genuinely stuck reply now takes up to 120 seconds per gate to fail instead of 30; both gates together stay under the suite's 5-minute testTimeout.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact sandbox:docker leg was not reproducible locally (no Docker daemon on this runner); the failure's CI log was not readable from the fix environment, so the diagnosis rests on code tracing plus the repo's documented loaded-runner history (#10904, #13552). If the flake recurs on this test, the next step is reading the CI log for the exact assertion that fired.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14191

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

这个 PR 通过放宽交互式 E2E 套件 `saved workflow slash-command completion` 中两个等待工作流完成通知后模型回复的屏幕等待预算（从 30 秒放宽到 120 秒，即 `waitForScreen` 测试框架的默认值），来消除该套件的偶发失败，并用注释记录了这个更大预算存在的原因。

## 为什么需要

主分支 CI 在 `E2E Test (Linux) - sandbox:docker - shard 1/1` 任务上的 `delivers 'WORKFLOW_LARGE_RESULT_12176' once` 失败过一次（#14191）。失败时的提交只涉及 Java SDK，所以这是偶发失败而不是回归。docker 分支把整个套件放在单个分片里、在共享主机上以三路 fork 并发运行，而本仓库已经有记录表明 30 秒预算在那里太紧：cron 交互套件在 #10904 之后把模型轮次确认放宽到 240 秒，就绪提示预算在 #13552 观察到自托管主机启动停顿超过 30 秒后提高到 90 秒。这个测试把框架默认的 120 秒向下覆盖成了 30 秒，而失败的用例恰好是六个用例中负载最重的（30,000 字符的工作流结果），即在负载下最慢结束的用例——这与预算型偶发恰好命中该用例一致。没有改动生产代码。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

确认 diff 只是放宽了工作流完成交互测试中两个回复等待的预算，并且套件仍然通过：运行 `cd integration-tests && QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run interactive/workflow-completion.test.ts`，预期 6/6 通过（约 2 分钟）。评审者也可以通过阅读这两个等待来确认失败模式：两者都在轮询只有在工作流结束、通知投递之后才会渲染的 fake server 回复文本，因此负载高的运行器确实可能需要超过 30 秒。

### 前后对比证据

N/A（仅测试侧的时间改动，没有 UI 行为变化）。改动前：主分支 CI docker 分支在 30 秒回复等待上失败过一次（#14191）。改动后：两个回复等待都使用 120 秒的框架默认值；完整套件本地 6/6 通过（107 秒），并且对之前失败用例的 3 路并发负载冒烟 3/3 通过。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

本地 Linux 运行器，`QWEN_SANDBOX=false`（无可用 Docker 守护进程）；sandbox:docker 分支本身由 CI 覆盖。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：真正卡住的回复现在每个 gate 最多需要 120 秒才会失败，而不是 30 秒；两个 gate 合计仍低于套件 5 分钟的 testTimeout。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：无法在本地精确复现 sandbox:docker 分支（本运行器没有 Docker 守护进程）；修复环境无法读取失败的 CI 日志，因此诊断基于代码链路梳理加上仓库已记录的负载主机历史（#10904、#13552）。如果该测试再次偶发失败，下一步是读取 CI 日志确认具体触发的断言。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14191

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): repair daily failure reporting and contract guards
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Repair daily CI failure reporting and the lightweight contract guard after #14205. Scheduled Desktop failures are identified by the workflow's canonical name rather than its rendered run title. Packaging failures without a test identifier are grouped by their full platform job and failed step, so a standing failure updates one issue across commits.

Contract changes now include renamed files' previous paths, preventing a rename from silently bypassing the missing-document check. Gate freshness runs before the schema guards so stale branches receive the actionable merge-main message first.

## Why it's needed

Post-merge review and real-environment verification found that Desktop's custom run title prevented scheduled failures from reaching the issue route, unsupported Desktop log formats fell back to per-commit issues, and renaming the contract document skipped its guard. The existing workflow suites are updated alongside these fixes. The three stale-trigger test suites were already repaired by #14227; this follow-up starts from that main commit and retains #14178's Hosted test repair.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- A failed scheduled Desktop run on main should enter issue analysis even though its run title is `Desktop checks (main)`. PR, manual and non-main runs should retain the existing exclusions.
- Repeated Desktop packaging failures in the same platform job and step should update the same issue across commits. Different platforms or failed steps should remain distinct; identified test failures and other workflows should retain their existing handling.
- A PR renaming the contract document should reach the missing-document check. Unrelated PRs should still skip that check.
- A stale PR should fail the freshness gate before either schema guard, while current branches run the guards before installing dependencies.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Read the failed jobs from run 38594075052 and the post-merge review on #14205. Lint failed the stale-gate check; the Hosted assertion failure is already addressed in #14178. The three obsolete workflow-trigger suites are already addressed in #14227. Executed locally at head `d2fd89c3` on macOS: the six workflow suites this PR touches (137 tests), `.github/scripts/ci/main-failure-signature.test.mjs` (59) and `.github/scripts/check-lint-gate-freshness.test.mjs` (9) all pass, and the rename bypass was reproduced against a renamed-file API fixture. Tables are in the verification comment. Scheduled GitHub runs and automatic issue creation were still not exercised.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | ✅ Local suites run |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not run |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not run locally (PR CI covers) |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — CI reporting and guard configuration.

## Risk & Scope

- Desktop failures without recognized test IDs are grouped by platform job and step; different causes at the same step share an issue until the step changes.
- The focused regression assertions were executed locally and pass. Scheduled execution and issue creation remain unverified for this patch: the trigger-level `workflows: ['Desktop Checks']` match is first exercised by the 16:00 UTC daily run.
- Daily cadence, application code and release behavior are unchanged. No migration is required.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #14205. Retains fixes already merged in #14178 and #14227.

后续修复 #14205；保留已合并的 #14178 和 #14227 修复。

prs.title: fix(Managed agent): settle never-started background dispatches in the live turn
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A failed background Shell dispatch now settles its child task in the live Turn when the original Broker definitively proves no process was admitted. This covers reservations that never created a publication row. Present, unknown, rejected or mismatched process results remain unresolved; Monitor dispatches keep their existing proof path.

## Why it's needed

The in-turn failure path depended on closing a publication row that might not exist. Its failed proof left an admitted task at running/dispatch_started indefinitely, even though the reload reconciliation could later prove the process never started.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Refuse a background reservation before its publication row is created. Confirm the original process lookup returns typed runtime_execution_not_found and the resident task becomes failed/not_started_proven without reopening the Session. Repeat with a present process row or unavailable Broker and confirm the task remains unresolved.

### Evidence (Before & After)

On base 21b78c55, the absence regression failed because the last operation remained dispatchStarted; the ambiguous-proof controls passed. After main integration, the candidate passes all 293 tool-turn/Broker/reconciliation/workflow-child tests. Dedicated macOS/H2-file and native Linux/MySQL 8.4 cases pass: three reserve refusals leave no publication row; the real Broker returns typed process-not-found; the durable record and public task become failed with not_started_proven, without Session reopen or a Shell side effect. The witness covers task settlement before Session reopen; final Turn liveness is not qualified. No UI layout changes. The process-fault cases above ran on the frozen pre-integration candidate (base 21b78c55 plus the same fixes). Its CLI bundle, Java executable packaging, Checkstyle and independent correctness/security source reviews passed. After integration with main c5098a27, repository build/typecheck, changed-file ESLint/Prettier, 293 CLI tests and 193 Java tests pass. Delivered-head CI remains pending.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Focused regression, build and controlled JDBC fault case |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Native Linux / MySQL 8.4 fault case |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64 and Ubuntu 24.04 arm64 (kernel 6.8), Node 22.22.0, JDK 21. Isolated H2-file and fresh MySQL 8.4 databases, controlled model provider, unused mocked object-store seam and internal team-lead profile. A labelled private transport producer supplies captureBytes=1 MiB; the Java public connector does not enable that lane today. No capability flags are faked. This no-dispatch case does not certify actual Linux Shell containment or a real provider.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Only the original Broker process ledger can supply the fallback proof. Publication absence itself, timeout or a generic 404 must never authorize terminal settlement.
- Not validated / out of scope: Monitor absence proof, successful completion of the remaining uncertain batch, periodic reconciliation, and full Linux/production qualification are separate work.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No public route, schema or protocol field changes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/38e56932ec96b308f03db7212f5b65377e92e1c0/docs/design/2026-10-11-never-started-dispatch-reconcile.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/38e56932ec96b308f03db7212f5b65377e92e1c0/docs/design/2026-10-11-never-started-dispatch-reconcile.zh-CN.md). Both versions are synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13937. Related programme: #12380.

## 本 PR 的变更

## 评审验收计划

### 如何验证

### 已测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 定向回归、构建及受控 JDBC 故障场景 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 原生 Linux / MySQL 8.4 故障场景 |

macOS arm64 和 Ubuntu 24.04 arm64（内核 6.8）、Node 22.22.0、JDK 21。使用独立 H2 文件库、新建 MySQL 8.4、受控模型、未使用的对象存储 mock 和内部 team-lead profile。明确标记的私有传输 producer 提供 captureBytes=1 MiB；当前 Java 公共 connector 尚未开启这条 lane。未伪造能力标志。本次从未派发场景不能证明真实 Linux Shell 进程隔离或真实 provider 资格。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：后备证明只能来自原 Broker 进程账本。publication 缺失、超时或普通 404 都不能授权终态结算。
- 未验证或范围外：Monitor 行缺失证明、其余不确定批次的成功完成、周期对账，以及完整 Linux/生产资格均为独立工作。
- 接口及迁移：不增加公共路由、schema 或协议字段。

设计：[English](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/38e56932ec96b308f03db7212f5b65377e92e1c0/docs/design/2026-10-11-never-started-dispatch-reconcile.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/38e56932ec96b308f03db7212f5b65377e92e1c0/docs/design/2026-10-11-never-started-dispatch-reconcile.zh-CN.md)。两版保持同步。

Fixes #13937。上层计划：#12380。

prs.title: test(cli): skip the chmod-based tests where permission bits do not bind
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Some cli tests force a failure by making a directory or file read-only or mode 000 and expect the operation to be refused. Where permission bits do not bind the process, the refusal never comes: Windows ignores Unix-style bits, and root bypasses them. As root, six of these tests fail every time, and five more report passed without reaching the path they test (two return early on uid 0, three pass vacuously).

This PR adds a small test helper, `arePermissionBitsEnforced()`, that asks the kernel instead of guessing. It creates a temporary directory, sets it to mode 000, and answers true only when both listing the directory and writing into it are refused with EACCES. On Windows it answers false without probing, and any unexpected error (a temp directory that refuses chmod, say) also answers false, so the probe can never fail a test file. When it cannot measure, it writes one line to stderr naming the errno, the system call and the test file that asked (vitest's `silent: true` drops console output), so those skips show in the job log instead of passing for a Windows or root run. All eleven tests now use `it.skipIf(!arePermissionBitsEnforced())`; the ones that returned early become `it.skipIf`, so a run that cannot exercise them reports them as skipped instead of passed.

Failing as root before this PR:
- `serve/workspace-agents`: "returns 500 agent_delete_partial when one level unlink silently fails"
- `serve/workspace-memory`: "omits errorMessage + filePath in 500/413 responses unless QWEN_SERVE_DEBUG is on"
- `serve/fs/workspace-file-system`: "throws AggregateError when every workspace root glob fails"
- `utils/housekeeping/cleanup`: "counts errors and continues sweep when one dir cannot be removed", "rejects when the log directory cannot be scanned", "counts errors and continues when a file cannot be unlinked"

Passing as root without exercising their path:
- `serve/fs/workspace-file-system`: "returns healthy root glob results when one workspace root fails" (vacuous), "writeTextOverwrite succeeds over an existing 0o000 (unreadable) file" (early return on uid 0)
- `serve/conversations/conversation-workspace`: "sanitizes standalone child filesystem errors" (early return on uid 0)
- `serve/multi-workspace-sessions`: "falls back to live-only listing when persisted probing fails" (vacuous)
- `commands/review/capture-tui`: "degrades rather than falsely claiming a swap when staging itself fails" (vacuous)

Most of the raw diff in the touched test files is re-indentation from wrapping each body in `it.skipIf(...)(...)`; `git diff -w` shows the real change.

## Why it's needed

Run as root, as on many dev containers and test machines, `packages/cli` fails these six every time, which buries real failures among known noise, and the other five claim coverage they do not give. A uid-0 check would fix local runs, but `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs unit tests on root lanes through `setpriv`, dropping CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE and CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH so that permission tests still exercise their paths there; a uid check silently skips them on such a lane. The probe keeps them running wherever the bits actually bind.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run src/test-utils/permission-bits.test.ts src/serve/workspace-agents.test.ts src/serve/workspace-memory.test.ts src/serve/fs/workspace-file-system.test.ts src/utils/housekeeping/cleanup.test.ts src/serve/conversations/conversation-workspace.test.ts src/serve/multi-workspace-sessions.test.ts src/commands/review/capture-tui.test.ts
```

As a regular user the eleven tests run and pass; as root they report skipped.

Results on Linux x86_64 for the seven touched test files (this host runs everything as root):

| Setup | Result |
| --- | --- |
| main before this PR, as root | 6 failed (the six above), 651 passed, 4 skipped |
| this PR, as root | 646 passed, 15 skipped (the eleven, plus four that already skipped) |
| this PR, as uid 1000 (`unshare --user --map-user=1000`) | 660 passed, 1 skipped |
| this PR, as root without DAC capabilities (ci.yml's `setpriv` flags) | 657 passed, 4 skipped |

The one test skipped everywhere has an unrelated condition. In the last row, the other three are capture-tui tests that already skip on `process.getuid?.() === 0`: on a root lane without DAC capabilities a uid check loses them, while the eleven guarded by the probe run.

- The helper's own tests drive each branch through a mocked `node:fs` (both refused, listing allowed, writing allowed, EPERM instead of EACCES, EMFILE, ENOSPC from mkdtemp, chmod refused, unprintable thrown values, stderr refusing the line, Windows), check that the probe is made in `os.tmpdir()` and removed, and check that the diagnostic appears exactly when the probe could not measure. Each of sixteen mutations of the helper (among them a uid check instead of the probe, dropping either check, accepting any errno, probing in a fixed `/tmp`, dropping or misplacing the diagnostic, writing it with `console.warn`, letting it throw) fails them, both as root and as uid 1000.
- Full `packages/cli` suite as root at this head (`npx vitest run`, coverage off): 41877 passed, 128 skipped, 0 failed. Before this PR, the six tests above were its only failures as root.
- ESLint (`--max-warnings 0`) and Prettier on the changed files: clean.
- Review: three rounds, each with an open-ended and an adversarial reviewer. Round 1, on an earlier version that skipped on uid 0, found the three cleanup tests that also fail as root and that a uid check would skip these tests on ci.yml's root lanes. Round 2 found that the helper's own tests could not catch a regression, four more tests that passed as root without exercising their path, and a probe error that could fail a whole test file. All are fixed here. Round 3 found no Critical.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (tests only; see the table above).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

macOS and Windows are left to CI. On Windows the probe answers false, so the eleven report skipped there: six already did, four used to return early and report passed, and one ran unguarded. A review audit ran the probe on a macOS host (arm64, regular user): it answered true and left no directory behind.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the probe runs at collection time, once per `skipIf`, eleven times across seven files, each creating and removing one temporary directory (about 20 µs). A probe that cannot run answers false, so the affected tests skip rather than fail.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows locally. About thirty existing `process.getuid?.() === 0` skips in cli (for example the three capture-tui tests above) could move to the probe, and other packages have root-only failures of the same kind, found in a run as root: core (`skill-curator` "reports skippedErrors when rename fails transiently", two in `git-worktrees`, `session-writer-lease` "classifies an unreadable owned lock as unavailable"), `channels/wecom` ("continues attachment cleanup when one dir removal fails"), and four in `scripts/tests` (`qwen-pr-review-workflow`, `qwen-autofix-workflow`). Both are left for follow-ups.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test code only.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

cli 中有些测试会把目录或文件设为只读或 000 权限来制造失败，并期望操作被拒绝。在权限位对进程不生效的环境里，这种拒绝根本不会发生：Windows 忽略 Unix 风格的权限位，root 会绕过它们。以 root 运行时，其中六个测试每次都会失败，另有五个报告通过却根本没走到它要测的路径（两个在 uid 为 0 时提前返回，三个是空过）。

本 PR 新增一个小的测试辅助函数 `arePermissionBitsEnforced()`，直接向内核求证而不是靠猜。它创建一个临时目录，设为 000 权限，只有列目录和在其中写文件都以 EACCES 被拒时才返回 true。在 Windows 上不做探测，直接返回 false；遇到任何意外错误（例如临时目录拒绝 chmod）也返回 false，因此探测永远不会让测试文件失败。无法测量时，它会向 stderr 写一行，说明 errno、系统调用和发起探测的测试文件（vitest 的 `silent: true` 会丢弃 console 输出），这样这类跳过会出现在任务日志里，而不会被当成 Windows 或 root 下的正常跳过。这十一个测试现在都使用 `it.skipIf(!arePermissionBitsEnforced())`；原来提前返回的改为 `it.skipIf`，这样无法真正执行它们的运行会报告为 skipped，而不是 passed。

本 PR 之前以 root 运行会失败的：
- `serve/workspace-agents`："returns 500 agent_delete_partial when one level unlink silently fails"
- `serve/workspace-memory`："omits errorMessage + filePath in 500/413 responses unless QWEN_SERVE_DEBUG is on"
- `serve/fs/workspace-file-system`："throws AggregateError when every workspace root glob fails"
- `utils/housekeeping/cleanup`："counts errors and continues sweep when one dir cannot be removed"、"rejects when the log directory cannot be scanned"、"counts errors and continues when a file cannot be unlinked"

以 root 运行时报告通过、却没走到要测路径的：
- `serve/fs/workspace-file-system`："returns healthy root glob results when one workspace root fails"（空过）、"writeTextOverwrite succeeds over an existing 0o000 (unreadable) file"（uid 为 0 时提前返回）
- `serve/conversations/conversation-workspace`："sanitizes standalone child filesystem errors"（uid 为 0 时提前返回）
- `serve/multi-workspace-sessions`："falls back to live-only listing when persisted probing fails"（空过）
- `commands/review/capture-tui`："degrades rather than falsely claiming a swap when staging itself fails"（空过）

这些测试文件的原始 diff 大部分是把测试体包进 `it.skipIf(...)(...)` 带来的重新缩进；用 `git diff -w` 可以看到真正的改动。

## 为什么需要

以 root 运行（很多开发容器和测试机都是如此）时，`packages/cli` 每次都会挂这六个测试，真正的失败因此淹没在已知噪声里；另外五个则声称提供了它们实际没有的覆盖。按 uid 0 判断也能修好本地运行，但 `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 在 root 车道上会通过 `setpriv` 去掉 CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE 与 CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH 来运行单元测试，让权限类测试在那里依然走到要测的路径；按 uid 判断会让它们在这类车道上被静默跳过。探测的做法让它们在权限位真正生效的地方继续运行。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

```
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run src/test-utils/permission-bits.test.ts src/serve/workspace-agents.test.ts src/serve/workspace-memory.test.ts src/serve/fs/workspace-file-system.test.ts src/utils/housekeeping/cleanup.test.ts src/serve/conversations/conversation-workspace.test.ts src/serve/multi-workspace-sessions.test.ts src/commands/review/capture-tui.test.ts
```

以普通用户运行时，这十一个测试都会执行并通过；以 root 运行时报告为 skipped。

在 Linux x86_64 上、七个被修改的测试文件的结果（本机所有操作都以 root 运行）：

| 环境 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 本 PR 之前的 main，root | 6 个失败（即上述六个）、651 个通过、4 个 skipped |
| 本 PR，root | 646 个通过、15 个 skipped（这十一个，加上原本就跳过的四个） |
| 本 PR，uid 1000（`unshare --user --map-user=1000`） | 660 个通过、1 个 skipped |
| 本 PR，去掉 DAC 能力的 root（ci.yml 的 `setpriv` 参数） | 657 个通过、4 个 skipped |

所有环境都跳过的那一个测试，跳过条件与权限无关。最后一行里另外三个是 capture-tui 中原本就按 `process.getuid?.() === 0` 跳过的测试：在去掉 DAC 能力的 root 车道上，按 uid 判断会丢掉它们，而用探测守护的这十一个都会执行。

- 辅助函数自己的测试通过 mock `node:fs` 逐个驱动每个分支（都被拒、可以列目录、可以写入、EPERM 而非 EACCES、EMFILE、mkdtemp 的 ENOSPC、chmod 被拒、无法打印的抛出值、stderr 拒绝写入、Windows），检查探测目录建在 `os.tmpdir()` 下且会被删除，并检查诊断恰好在探测无法测量时出现。对辅助函数做的十六种变异（其中包括用 uid 判断代替探测、去掉任一项检查、接受任意 errno、在固定的 `/tmp` 下探测、去掉或错放诊断、改用 `console.warn` 输出、让诊断抛错）在 root 和 uid 1000 下都会让这些测试失败。
- 本 head 上以 root 运行 `packages/cli` 全量（`npx vitest run`，关闭覆盖率）：41877 个通过、128 个 skipped、0 个失败。本 PR 之前，root 下全量运行的失败只有上述六个测试。
- 变更文件的 ESLint（`--max-warnings 0`）与 Prettier：干净。
- 评审：共三轮，每轮一个无方向审计与一个对抗审计。第 1 轮针对的是按 uid 0 跳过的早期版本，发现 cleanup 中另外三个在 root 下同样失败的测试，以及按 uid 判断会让这些测试在 ci.yml 的 root 车道上被跳过。第 2 轮发现辅助函数自己的测试抓不住退化、另有四个测试在 root 下报告通过却没走到要测的路径，以及探测出错会让整个测试文件失败。以上都已在本 PR 修复。第 3 轮没有 Critical。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用（只改测试，见上表）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

macOS 与 Windows 交给 CI。在 Windows 上探测直接返回 false，这十一个测试在那里报告为 skipped：六个原本就跳过，四个过去提前返回、报告为 passed，还有一个过去没有任何守卫。一次评审审计在 macOS 主机上（arm64，普通用户）运行过探测：返回 true，且没有留下目录。

### 环境（可选）

只有单元测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：探测在测试收集阶段执行，每个 `skipIf` 一次，七个文件共十一次，每次创建并删除一个临时目录（约 20 微秒）。无法运行的探测返回 false，相关测试会跳过而不是失败。
- 未验证或不在范围内：本地未在 macOS 与 Windows 上验证。cli 中现有约三十处 `process.getuid?.() === 0` 跳过条件（例如上面提到的三个 capture-tui 测试）也可以改用这个探测；其他包里也有同类只在 root 下失败的测试，是在一次 root 运行中发现的：core（`skill-curator` 的 "reports skippedErrors when rename fails transiently"、`git-worktrees` 的两个、`session-writer-lease` 的 "classifies an unreadable owned lock as unavailable"）、`channels/wecom`（"continues attachment cleanup when one dir removal fails"），以及 `scripts/tests` 中的四个（`qwen-pr-review-workflow`、`qwen-autofix-workflow`）。两者都留给后续 PR。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无；只改测试代码。
