prs.title: fix(ci): enforce Flyway migration ordering
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Both Flyway gates reject newly added migration versions that are not strictly greater than the highest published version across all scanned Maven modules and SQL/Java locations. PR CI reads a fetched snapshot of the actual target branch; the open-PR recheck recomputes the maximum from current main. Historical paths remain exempt, and duplicate-version diagnostics and status names are preserved.

Versions compare numerically after normalization, including dot/underscore equivalence, leading and trailing zero segments, and integers beyond JavaScript's safe range. An explicitly configured unreadable baseline fails closed. Local verification uses complete, unfiltered history and the PR's actual base branch. A readable baseline with no published migrations still permits the first migration and explicitly reports that ordering was not checked.

The lightweight ordering check follows the current main CI layout: PR lint fetches one baseline SHA and shares it with the API contract check. Full Java runs retain main's daily/manual schedule. A lost-release-reply test now gates background cleanup retries until its observation boundary is recorded, preserving all original identity, no-replay, model-count, and blocked-state assertions.

Boolean CHECK validation now applies the same unquoted TRUE/FALSE normalization to CASE, non-CASE and generated expressions, while preserving quoted strings and boolean grouping. Regression coverage accepts numeric equivalents and rejects changed values, operators and string literals.

## Why it's needed

A unique V58 can pass a uniqueness-only check after V64 is published, leaving upgraded databases with an unapplied lower migration. Both PR-time checking and rechecking after main advances are needed to enforce the existing migration allocation rule. The cleanup witness also had a timing race: a resident background retry could complete before its traffic snapshot, causing the test to report that no retry occurred even when one had succeeded.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Publish Java V64 in one module and add unique SQL V58 in another. Both gates should reject V58 and name V64 as the maximum. V65 should pass, duplicate V64 should retain the collision diagnostic, and unchanged historical paths should remain valid.
2. Recheck a previously green V65 PR after main publishes V66. Its status should become failure. A known lower version should still fail when the PR's file list is incomplete.
3. Check normalized versions, large integers, reuse after deleting a published migration, an unreadable baseline, an empty migration location's first migration, and fixture independence from ambient Git signing settings.
4. Run all eight broker reply-loss scenarios on real MySQL. Delaying the witness before its traffic snapshot must not cause a false missing-retry failure. Recovery across detach/load must retry only the original cleanup, without replaying tool effects or model calls. Generated-column validation should still reject changed boolean fallbacks and quoted string substitutions.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- UI/TUI: N/A.
- Before: the previous head failed lint freshness, the MariaDB first-writer readiness barrier, and the hosted MySQL cleanup-retry assertion. Adding only a 1.5-second observation delay reproduced the exact hosted assertion on Linux: two release requests had already completed before the snapshot.
- After: the same delayed control passes with the retry gate. The uninstrumented original Java test passes all eight fault scenarios on Linux/real MySQL, with no scenarios disabled. The first-writer witness passes after incorporating main's existing deadlock fix.
- Frozen pnpm installation, build, bundle, all workspace/integration typechecks, source ESLint, actionlint, YAML and formatting checks passed. Seven relevant script suites passed 348 cases with 10 existing platform/capability skips. The changed verification-document assertion also passed after its CI pointer was updated.
- The requested-changes regression round passed 116 Flyway/workflow cases and 27 Java schema cases (7 catalog + 20 schema), with zero skips. Both reported failures were reproduced before fixing them; all 16 non-CASE semantic drift controls still reject changes. These Java cases use the existing H2 metadata fixture. The earlier live-database round passed Backfill 3/3, real MariaDB schema 2/2 and the original first-writer witness 1/1. Java Checkstyle reported zero violations and SpotBugs reported zero bugs/errors. Merge/Flyway and cleanup-driver reviews found no blocking defects.
- The previous head passed hosted Lint & Static and no-AK integration checks; its Ubuntu unit-test job hit the existing one-hour timeout. Hosted results for the new requested-changes commit are pending.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS 15.7.2 | Build, bundle, typechecks, source/static checks, script suites and MariaDB witnesses passed. |
| Windows | Not rerun locally for this updated head. |
| Linux aarch64 container | Original hosted Java method passed all eight fault scenarios against real MySQL, including the delayed before/after control. |

Local tools: pinned pnpm 11.24.0, Maven 3.9.11 and Java 21. macOS used Node 26.0.0 and MariaDB 10.11.19; Linux used Node 22.23.3 and MySQL 8.4.11.

## Risk & Scope

- A previously green PR adding a lower unique version must renumber above the latest published version. The asynchronous merge/recheck race window remains.
- Full hosted fault-gate and non-hosted Java profiles were not rerun locally; the original failures and affected schema/Backfill witnesses were verified directly. Existing platform/capability skips remain, and no new skips or disabled checks were introduced.
- No migration contents or numbering, dependencies, public API or runtime configuration are changed by this PR. Push/daily/manual checking retains uniqueness behavior because it has no PR baseline. English and Chinese [design documentation](https://github.com/ZedingZhang/qwen-code/blob/fix/13922-flyway-migration-order/docs/design/2026-09-28-managed-agent-durable-lifecycle.md) / [中文设计文档](https://github.com/ZedingZhang/qwen-code/blob/fix/13922-flyway-migration-order/docs/design/2026-09-28-managed-agent-durable-lifecycle.zh-CN.md) are synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13922

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

两个 Flyway 门禁都会拒绝新增版本号不严格高于所有扫描 Maven 模块及 SQL、Java 目录中已发布最高版本的迁移。PR CI 读取实际目标分支的已获取快照；开放 PR 重查使用当时最新的 main。历史路径不受新增排序检查影响，重复版本诊断和状态名称保持原有行为。

版本按归一化后的数字分段比较，支持点号与下划线等价、前导零及末尾零分段，以及超出 JavaScript 安全整数范围的整数。显式配置的基线无法读取时检查会失败。本地验证使用完整且未过滤的历史，并读取 PR 实际的 base 分支。 可读基线中没有已发布迁移时，仍允许首个迁移，并明确提示未执行排序检查。

轻量排序检查适配 main 当前的 CI 布局：PR lint 获取一次基线 SHA，并与 API 契约检查共享。完整 Java 检查保留 main 的每日或手动调度。丢失 release 响应的测试会先记录流量观测起点，再放行后台清理重试，保留原有身份、不重复执行、模型调用次数和阻塞状态断言。

布尔 CHECK 校验现在对 CASE、非 CASE 和生成表达式使用同一套未加引号的 TRUE/FALSE 归一化，同时保留引号字符串和布尔分组。回归覆盖允许等价数字表示，仍拒绝值、运算符和字符串字面量变化。

## 为什么需要

仅检查唯一性会让 V64 已发布后的唯一 V58 通过，使已升级数据库遗留未应用的低版本迁移。PR 提交时检查和 main 推进后的重查都不可缺少，才能执行既有迁移编号规则。清理测试还存在时序竞态：常驻后台重试可能早于流量快照完成，即使重试已经成功，测试仍会报告没有发生重试。

## 供审查者验证

1. 跨模块发布 Java V64、新增唯一 SQL V58：两个门禁应拒绝 V58 并指出最高版本 V64；V65 应通过，重复 V64 保留撞号诊断，历史路径有效。
2. main 发布 V66 后重查此前通过的 V65：状态应变为失败。文件列表不完整时，已读到的低版本仍应失败。
3. 检查归一化版本、大整数、删除已发布迁移后的版本重用、不可读基线、空迁移目录的首个迁移，以及 Git signing 配置对测试夹具的隔离。
4. 在真实 MySQL 上执行全部八个 broker 响应丢失场景。观测快照前的延迟不应造成“没有重试”的误报；detach/load 前后的恢复只能重试原清理，不能重放工具副作用或增加模型调用。生成列检查仍须拒绝错误布尔兜底值和带引号的字符串替换。

## 前后证据

- UI/TUI：不适用。
- 修复前：上一 head 在 lint 新鲜度、MariaDB 首次写入就绪屏障和 MySQL 清理重试断言上失败。在 Linux 上只增加 1.5 秒观测延迟，即复现相同断言：快照前已经完成两次 release 请求。
- 修复后：相同延迟对照通过；未加调试代码的原始 Java 测试在 Linux 和真实 MySQL 上通过全部八个故障场景，没有禁用场景。合入 main 已有的死锁修复后，首次写入用例通过。
- 固定 pnpm 安装、构建、打包、全部工作区及集成类型检查、源文件 ESLint、actionlint、YAML 和格式检查通过。七个相关脚本套件有 348 项通过、10 项既有平台或能力限制的跳过。验证文档的 CI 指针更新后，对应断言也通过。
- 本次 requested-changes 回归有 116 个 Flyway/工作流用例和 27 个 Java schema 用例（7 个 catalog、20 个 schema）通过，零跳过。两处问题均先复现再修复；全部 16 个非 CASE 语义漂移控制仍能拒绝错误变化。本轮 Java 用例使用既有 H2 元数据夹具。此前真实数据库验证中，Backfill 3/3、MariaDB schema 2/2、原首次写入测试 1/1 全部通过。Java Checkstyle 零违规，SpotBugs 零 bug、零 error。合并与 Flyway 审查、清理测试审查均未发现阻塞缺陷。
- 上一 head 的托管 Lint & Static 和 no-AK 集成检查通过；Ubuntu 单元测试 job 达到原有一小时时限。本次 requested-changes 新提交的托管结果尚在等待。

## 验证环境

macOS 15.7.2 上完成构建、打包、类型检查、源文件及静态检查、脚本测试和 MariaDB 用例。Windows 未针对新 head 在本地重跑。Linux aarch64 容器中的原 hosted Java 方法在真实 MySQL 上通过全部八个场景及延迟前后对照。

使用固定 pnpm 11.24.0、Maven 3.9.11 和 Java 21。macOS 使用 Node 26.0.0、MariaDB 10.11.19；Linux 使用 Node 22.23.3、MySQL 8.4.11。

## 风险与范围

- 已通过但新增唯一低版本的 PR 需要重新编号；异步合入与重查之间仍存在竞态窗口。
- 没有在本地重跑完整 hosted fault-gate 和 non-hosted Java profile；原失败用例及受影响 schema、Backfill 用例已直接验证。保留既有平台限制，没有新增跳过或禁用检查。
- 本 PR 不修改迁移内容或编号、依赖、公共 API 和运行时配置。push、每日和手动检查没有 PR 基线，仍保留唯一性行为。上方链接的中英文设计文档保持同步。

修复 #13922。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ui): bottom-align short VP content so blank space is at top
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In VP mode (`useTerminalBuffer`, default on), when the conversation fits within the viewport the content was top-aligned, leaving a blank gap between the last message and the composer (reported in #9300, happens in every session). This bottom-aligns short bottom-stuck content: blank space moves to the TOP and the latest message sits directly above the composer, matching standard chat TUIs.

Implementation: in `VirtualizedList`, when `isStickingToBottom` and content fits (`maxScroll === 0`), compute `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight`, render it as a leading spacer, and keep the root at full `containerHeight` so there is room. Overflow (`maxScroll > 0`) and scrolled-away cases are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

#9300: default-on VP mode showed a large blank area between the last message and the composer in every session (short conversations and collapsed thinking blocks). High-frequency, default-on visual regression on the primary surface — worth a quick fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/VirtualizedList.test.tsx` — 32 tests pass, including the 3 updated to the new bottom-aligned layout.
2. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/MainContent.test.tsx packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/ScrollableList.test.tsx` — 36 pass (no layout regression).
3. Manual (iTerm2, VP mode): start a short session — content should sit at the bottom above the composer with blank at top; collapse a thinking block (Ctrl+O) — released space appears at top, not between content and composer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: content top-aligned, blank gap between last message and composer. After: content bottom-aligned, blank at top. (Needs a live terminal to visually confirm; unit tests pin the new frame layout.)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️ needs manual confirm (reported on iTerm2) |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ (unit tests) |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changes the short-content layout from top-aligned/collapsed to bottom-aligned; three tests that pinned the old collapse behavior were updated to the new expectation. Scrolling/overflow math is untouched (`scrollableContainerHeight` unchanged).
- Not validated / out of scope: live iTerm2 visual confirmation (reporter's environment); height-overestimation cases where `totalHeight >= containerHeight` (those already bottom-show via `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll`).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #9300

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

VP 模式（默认开启）下，当会话内容高度小于视口时，内容顶部对齐，导致最后一条消息与输入框之间出现大片空白（#9300，每个 session 都出现）。本 PR 将短的、贴底的内容改为底部对齐：空白移到顶部，最新消息紧贴输入框上方，与主流 chat TUI 一致。

实现：`VirtualizedList` 中当 `isStickingToBottom` 且内容放得下（`maxScroll === 0`）时，计算 `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight` 作为顶部占位，并保持 root 为满 `containerHeight`。溢出或已上滚的场景不变。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：短内容布局从顶部对齐/折叠改为底部对齐，3 个固定旧行为的测试已更新；滚动数学未动。
- 未验证：iTerm2 真机视觉确认；`totalHeight >= containerHeight` 的高度高估场景（该场景本就通过 `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll` 底部显示）。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): keep one-shot system reminders out of the user's own message
prs.body:
## What this PR does

One-shot reminders that the interactive terminal UI folds into the front of a prompt are no longer shown back to the user. The transcript line for a prompt, the entry written to the cross-session ↑-recall history, the text refilled into the composer after a cancelled turn, and the same prompt as rebuilt when a session is resumed now all show what the user typed. The request sent to the model still carries the reminder exactly as before, and the machine-readable sidecar mirror of the conversation is deliberately left untouched, because its job is to report what was actually sent.

Removal is leading-only: a reminder tag the user pasted into the middle of their own prompt stays visible, and a tag that is never closed is left in place rather than swallowed. If a prompt were nothing but an envelope, the transcript keeps showing it rather than rendering an empty bubble.

## Why it's needed

Resuming a session that still had paused background agents made the first prompt render as a block of internal instructions — how to list agents, and how to message one by task id — followed by the user's own words. The user never wrote that text and cannot act on it. Cancelling the turn put the same block into the editable input box, so resubmitting sent internal context to the model as literal user text, and resuming that session again replayed it from the recording. This was reported internally during token-consumption governance work.

None of it was needed to keep the user informed. Each of the three notices that can be injected this way already has its own user-facing signal: restored background agents and a restored worktree each add an info line to the transcript, and workflow keyword steering lights an indicator in the footer. The headless and ACP runtimes both attach the notice as a separate part alongside the prompt rather than folding it in, so the interactive terminal path was the only one mixing a model-only payload into the string it also renders, logs and restores. This separates the two roles again at the points where a prompt is read back, instead of restructuring how the notice is delivered — the delivery side is threaded through the submission queue, speculation matching and side-question routing, and rewriting it is a much larger change than the defect warrants.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a session, launch a background agent, leave it paused/recoverable, exit, then `qwen --resume` that session.
2. Type any first prompt. Before: the transcript shows a `<system-reminder>` block reading "1 background agent was restored from this session. Use list_agents to inspect it and send_message with a task_id to continue one.", a blank line, then the prompt. After: only the prompt, with the separate info line "Restored 1 background agent from this session. Open Background tasks to inspect it." still present above it.
3. Confirm the model still receives the reminder — ask it what it was told about restored agents, or inspect the request payload in an API trace. It should be unchanged.
4. Cancel path: on that first prompt press ESC before any output arrives. The composer should refill with the prompt only, not the envelope. Resubmit and confirm the transcript is still clean.
5. ↑-recall: exit, start a new session in the same directory, press ↑. The recalled entry should be the prompt without the envelope.
6. Resume again: `qwen --resume` the session from step 1 and confirm the earlier prompt now renders without the envelope (this is the recording-replay path, fixed separately from the live path).
7. Paste guard: submit `before <system-reminder>x</system-reminder> after` and confirm the transcript shows it verbatim.
8. The worktree and workflow-steering notices reproduce the same way through their own one-shot latches (`--worktree`, or a prompt containing the workflow keyword with the feature enabled); both should now render only the user's words while keeping their info line and footer indicator.

Automated:

```bash
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run \
  src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.test.tsx \
  src/ui/utils/resumeHistoryUtils.test.ts \
  src/ui/utils/historyUtils.test.ts \
  src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx
# 554 passed
npx tsc --noEmit            # clean
npx eslint <changed files>  # clean
npx prettier --check <changed files>  # clean
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

No terminal recording for this one — evidence is at the unit level, and I'm flagging that explicitly rather than implying a TUI capture was done.

- After: two new cases pin the live path (model request keeps the envelope while the transcript and the recall log carry only the user's words; stacked envelopes strip, mid-message and unterminated ones do not) and two pin the resume path (an envelope-only record restores as the bare prompt; a pasted envelope survives).
- Before: three pre-existing cancel-path expectations pinned the old text — they asserted the envelope inside the value that is both compared for identity and written back into the composer. Those three had to be updated, which is the direct before/after evidence for the cancel-restore path.
- Not run locally to completion: the full `packages/cli` suite. Every test file that mentions the reminder tag was run individually and passes, no snapshot contains it, and CI covers the rest.
- Pre-existing and unrelated: `src/acp-integration/session/Session.worktree.test.ts` fails 8 tests with `this.config.setCurrentSessionScheduledTaskCreator is not a function`. Verified identical on the base commit `0ef35351e9` with this branch's changes absent — the test's mocked config lacks a method the ACP session now calls. Not touched here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS: unit tests, typecheck, lint and format on the changed files. No manual TUI run and no Windows/Linux run — the change is string handling with no platform-specific branch, but the manual steps above are the ones worth walking on a real terminal.

Fixes #11553

prs.title: test(permissions): cover persistent rule removal
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds five regression cases for removal of active persistent permission rules. The tests exercise the real permission manager with Agent calls, cover allow/ask/deny decisions after removal, preserve unrelated targets and session rules, and verify that an exact raw-string/type mismatch leaves the rule active.

## Why it's needed

Item 3 of #10235 tracks missing coverage for this deletion operation. The existing UI/ACP caller tests mock the manager, so they cannot detect a deletion that reports success while leaving the permission active. Removing the actual deletion action preserves the baseline suite's 555 passing cases; these new tests expose four additional failures under the same mutation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Verify that removing each active persistent rule changes the affected Agent permission decision to default while another target retains its original decision. Repeated or unmatched removal must return false. Removing persistent deny, ask, and allow rules in sequence must retain the other rule types until they are separately removed and must preserve a matching session allow rule. Temporarily suppressing the actual deletion should fail four new cases; treating an unmatched lookup as the first rule should also fail four new cases. Restore production code after either probe.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-facing change. Focused tests: 5 passed. Complete file before: 555 passed / 12 failed / 567 total; after: 560 passed / 12 failed / 572 total. The failure-name sets are identical; all 12 failures are Windows symlink EPERM from the baseline. With deletion suppressed, the final file has 556 passed / 16 failed, including four new failures. The independent test engineer reproduced the baseline and final counts. All temporary production mutations were restored. The initial root build passed at ad91df5. At the tested base 9e9d1c0, root typecheck passed; the root build log confirmed package completion through CLI, and the final VS Code build and settings-schema steps passed when rerun separately. The combined latest root-build exit code was not captured. Whole-repository format and lint:ci passed during preflight at ad91df5; changed-file ESLint, Prettier, and diff whitespace checks passed. The complete preflight was interrupted during build; workspace-wide test:ci and the serve fast-path bundle gate were not completed, so no overall preflight pass is claimed. This is proposed as a Draft PR.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not tested |
| Windows | Focused tests passed; complete-file limitations recorded above |
| Linux | Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node.js 24.19.0, npm 11.17.0, pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Unit tests against local source; no live model API call or CLI E2E acceptance is claimed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: test-only coverage of the existing in-memory removal contract; no production changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: settings-file persistence, UI/ACP E2E flows, AUTO-stashed rules, and the other items in #10235.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #10235, item 3 only. The remaining items are intentionally left open.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为有效的持久化权限规则移除操作补充五项回归测试。测试通过真实权限管理器和 Agent 调用上下文，检查移除后的 allow/ask/deny 判定，保留其他目标及会话规则，并验证原始规则字符串或规则类型不匹配时已有规则仍然有效。

## 为什么需要

#10235 第 3 项记录了该删除操作缺少覆盖。现有 UI/ACP 调用方测试 mock 了权限管理器，无法发现“返回删除成功但权限仍然有效”的回归。临时去掉真正的删除动作后，基线仍保留 555 项通过；新增测试在相同变异下额外发现四项失败。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

逐一移除有效持久化规则后，对应 Agent 权限应回到 default，另一个目标仍保持原判定。重复删除或未匹配删除应返回 false。依次移除持久化 deny、ask、allow 规则时，应保留尚未单独移除的其他规则类型，并保留匹配的会话 allow 规则。临时停用真正的删除动作应使四项新测试失败；把未匹配查找误当成第一条规则也应使四项新测试失败。每次探测后恢复生产代码。

### 证据（修改前后）

- 主要风险或取舍：只增加现有内存规则移除契约的测试覆盖，不修改生产代码。

prs.title: fix(acp): persist embedded text resources for transcript replay
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Persists bounded, original ACP embedded text `resource` blocks with their owning user prompt and replays them as typed user chunks. The daemon UI SDK now exposes these blocks separately from `resource_link` and native attachments, including offline transcript projection. Native attachment expansions are identified by their input positions, so a separate direct resource remains replayable even when it shares the same URI.

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code already accepts embedded resources as model context, but refresh or restart previously restored only the prompt text. Clients therefore lost the original context selection while the assistant reply remained visible. This closes the persistence/replay gap tracked in #12538; it is separate from the `resource_link` fix in #12088.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Send an ACP prompt with text and a text resource, then a resource-only prompt and a later text-only prompt. Inspect the saved user records and load the transcript: each resource should appear as a typed user chunk on its original prompt with its URI, MIME type, text, metadata, prompt ID, and source-record identity; it must not migrate to the later turn or be fetched by URI. Also check rewind/active-branch replay, native attachments over 256 KiB, a direct resource sharing a native attachment URI, and rejection of an oversized direct text resource before the daemon peer echo. Focused bridge, CLI, persistence, and SDK tests cover these cases.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the new recording/replay regressions failed against the pre-fix source because typed resources were absent after replay. After: the focused tests pass, including resource-only, same-URI coexistence, and daemon pre-echo rejection. No running-daemon or browser recording is claimed here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ build, bundle, typecheck, targeted lint and tests |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Oversized direct text resources are rejected before live echo. Native attachments use their existing separate storage path; current daemon requests exclude them by provenance. Legacy metadata without positions excludes only unambiguous URI matches; ambiguous blocks are retained and may hit the inline limit.

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): admit team_plan_approval into the journal-only interrupted-turn settle (#13847)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A crash inside a journal-only batch is now settled by the takeover instead of terminally declined — but one member of that family still kept the old decline: the plan approval tool. It is declared as its own constant, outside the team-tools name list, so it never entered the settle's answerable family, and a crash after its committed decision still wedged the Session exactly as before. This PR admits it: the settle's family now names the plan approval tool, and since a committed plan decision's evidence lives on the teams funnel alone, the call requires only that funnel to be answerable.

## Why it's needed

Reviewer feedback on the merged #13847 fix pointed out the hole: the family that closes the crash window for background launches, workflows, messages, and team writes missed the plan approval tool for an avoidable naming reason, leaving the same blocked-Session shape reachable for that one tool. Keeping the decline for it is honest only when the evidence funnel is missing; with the funnel present, the takeover can answer from what committed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The regression rig is the same vitest suite driving only production modules: an arm stages a parked Turn owing an unanswered plan approval and drives the takeover with the teams evidence funnel present — it settles (the unanswered call is told as never run, the Turn's input settles, and the outcome converges) — and an arm with no teams funnel keeps the typed decline, proving the guard refuses a minted answer. Both pins go red under their mirror changes (dropping the tool from the family, or relaxing the funnel requirement).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change; evidence is the test output below.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the settle now answers plan approvals too; the same honesty gate applies — no evidence funnel, no settlement, typed decline kept.
- Not validated / out of scope: the committed-decision evidence path (answering with the recorded decision text), which rides the same pre-existing machinery the interrupted-turn funnel already uses.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): Standardize SQL timestamps and query mappings
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Standardizes all 77 Managed business timestamp columns as `BIGINT UNSIGNED` Unix epoch milliseconds, renames existing creation/modification columns to `gmt_create`/`gmt_modified`, and updates SQL readers, writers, recovery exports and private CLI wiring together. The filesystem `mount_birth_time` identity fingerprint retains its original string representation.

Replaces wildcard Managed reads with explicit projections, qualifies joined columns, advances existing modification timestamps atomically with successful business transitions, and uses typed receipt and JDBC scalar mappings. The 28 shared projections include the incoming V2 CSI authority fields. Public API timestamp names and existing units, immutable JSONL bytes, identity scopes, permission checks, keys, fencing and idempotency conditions retain their contracts.

## Why it's needed

The fresh database baseline mixed integer milliseconds with `DATETIME(6)`, so lease and recovery paths used different JDBC conversions and time arithmetic. Wildcard reads and generic result casts made schema evolution depend on driver behavior, and some successful mutations left their modification time unchanged. One explicit millisecond storage contract and deliberate query mappings make these paths consistent and verifiable.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Initialize a fresh MySQL 8.4 catalog and confirm every business timestamp is unsigned integer milliseconds, no business date/time column remains, and signed or mismatched catalogs are refused. Verify NULL, zero, post-2038 values and millisecond round-trips; negative values and values outside Java's signed range must be rejected instead of silently changing their meaning.

Verify a successful receipt settlement updates its modification time, an actor/request conflict leaves it unchanged, and replay preserves the original result. Exercise ordinary and private CSI Session paths, expired/live writer leases, stale claim refusal, pagination ties, retention cursors, and completed GC work remaining unclaimable. Confirm byte-exact JSONL replay, original identity/fencing evidence, and public timestamp names and per-DTO units. Full projections must preserve all V1/V2 fields while excluding a subsequently added unused column.

Local validation: SDK 247 tests, 0 failures/errors, 9 conditional skips; Broker 951 full-suite cases followed by corrected/final focused checks (87 in the final affected-path lane), yielding 953 distinct effective cases with 0 failures/errors and 2 skips; Server 2755 full-suite cases followed by 135 final affected-path cases, yielding 2756 distinct effective cases with 0 failures/errors and 7 skips. Native MySQL validation: 76 Broker cases plus 20 Server fixture and 262 Server integration cases, all with 0 failures/errors/skips. Broker/Server Checkstyle/SpotBugs and repository build, typecheck, bundle, plus changed-script formatting/lint passed. Actual JDBC/private CLI probes covered unsigned/NULL/2050 millisecond reads, expiry predicates, ACK inspect with immutable evidence, CSI Session create/replay, and Runtime SQL resolution up to its required Kubernetes API gate. Conditional skips and platform/prerequisite limits are reported in the separate validation comment.

Design and acceptance details: [query cleanup (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-sql-millisecond-timestamps/docs/design/2026-10-14-managed-sql-query-cleanup.md), [query cleanup (Chinese)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-sql-millisecond-timestamps/docs/design/2026-10-14-managed-sql-query-cleanup.zh-CN.md), [millisecond timestamps (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-sql-millisecond-timestamps/docs/design/2026-10-14-managed-sql-millisecond-timestamps.md), [millisecond timestamps (Chinese)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-sql-millisecond-timestamps/docs/design/2026-10-14-managed-sql-millisecond-timestamps.zh-CN.md).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — this change has no UI/TUI presentation. Database and API contract evidence is described above and in the separate validation comment.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js 22.22.3, JDK 25.0.2 targeting Java 21, Maven 3.9.14, task-owned MySQL 8.4.11, Connector/J 9.7.0. Java artifacts use an isolated local Maven repository; local SDK installation skipped GPG release signing because no signing key is configured.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Sub-millisecond precision is deliberately discarded. Unsigned storage remains subject to the application's signed Java `long` timestamp range. Every reader/writer and recovery cursor must agree on milliseconds; physical filesystem identity fingerprints retain their original precision and format.
- Not validated / out of scope: Linux/Windows execution, live Kubernetes/CSI/OSS and complete Hosted/Harness acceptance, the separate Broker fault-gate profile, external permission redesign, actor ownership changes, and primary/foreign-key restructuring.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: This updates the fresh database baseline and its checksum. It does not migrate existing databases; catalogs using the former timestamp columns/types require a separately designed migration before this version can use them. Incoming V2 CSI authority and existing keys/constraints remain intact.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次 PR 的改动

将全部 77 个 Managed 业务时间戳列统一为 `BIGINT UNSIGNED` Unix epoch 毫秒，将已有创建/修改列改名为 `gmt_create`/`gmt_modified`，并同步调整 SQL 读写、恢复导出和私有 CLI 接线。文件系统 `mount_birth_time` 身份指纹保留原始字符串表示。

将 Managed 星号查询改为明确字段投影，限定多表字段，在成功业务变更时原子推进已有修改时间，并使用类型化回执与 JDBC 标量映射。28 组共享投影包含新合入的 V2 CSI authority 字段。公开 API 时间字段名称和既有单位、不可变 JSONL 字节、身份作用域、权限检查、键、fencing 和幂等条件保持各自契约。

## 为什么需要

新库 baseline 混用整数毫秒与 `DATETIME(6)`，租约和恢复路径因此使用不同的 JDBC 转换和时间运算。星号查询与通用结果强转使结构演进依赖驱动行为，部分成功变更还遗漏修改时间。明确的毫秒存储契约与查询映射使这些路径保持一致，并能直接验证。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

初始化全新的 MySQL 8.4 数据库，确认全部业务时间戳为无符号整数毫秒，不再保留业务日期时间列，且拒绝有符号或不匹配的结构。验证 NULL、零、2038 年后的值和精确毫秒往返；负数及超出 Java 有符号范围的值应被拒绝，不能静默改变其含义。

验证回执成功结算推进修改时间，Actor/请求冲突不改变记录，幂等重放保留原结果。覆盖普通与私有 CSI Session 路径、有效/过期 writer 租约、过期领取拒绝、分页同值、保留游标，以及已完成 GC 工作不能再次领取。确认 JSONL 按字节精确重放、原始身份/fencing 证据和公开时间字段名称及每类 DTO 的单位。完整投影应保留全部 V1/V2 字段，同时排除随后新增但未使用的字段。

本地验证：SDK 247 个测试，零失败/错误，9 个条件跳过；Broker 951 个全量用例后完成修正与最终定向复验（最后受影响路径为 87 个），得到 953 个不重复有效用例，零失败/错误，2 个跳过；Server 2755 个全量用例后运行 135 个最终受影响路径用例，得到 2756 个不重复有效用例，零失败/错误，7 个跳过。真实 MySQL 验证：76 个 Broker、20 个 Server fixture 和 262 个 Server 集成用例，全部零失败/错误/跳过。Broker/Server Checkstyle/SpotBugs、仓库 build、typecheck、bundle 和修改脚本的格式/lint 通过。实际 JDBC/私有 CLI probe 覆盖 无符号/NULL/2050 年毫秒读取、到期条件、保留不可变证据的 ACK inspect、CSI Session 创建/重放，以及 Runtime SQL 解析到必需的 Kubernetes API 门禁。条件跳过以及平台/前置依赖限制在独立验证评论中记录。

设计和验收细节：[查询整理英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-sql-millisecond-timestamps/docs/design/2026-10-14-managed-sql-query-cleanup.md)、[查询整理中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-sql-millisecond-timestamps/docs/design/2026-10-14-managed-sql-query-cleanup.zh-CN.md)、[毫秒时间戳英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-sql-millisecond-timestamps/docs/design/2026-10-14-managed-sql-millisecond-timestamps.md)、[毫秒时间戳中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-sql-millisecond-timestamps/docs/design/2026-10-14-managed-sql-millisecond-timestamps.zh-CN.md)。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): hand one run's session messages over in send order
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The session message relay now hands one run's messages over in the order their sender committed them. Before a message is handed over, the relay checks whether the same sender has an older message to the same child run that still owes its handover or receipt (`planned`, `accepting` or `unknown`, on a ledger row that is neither classified nor past the attempt bound). If so, the younger message waits on the heartbeat without spending an attempt. Messages to other runs are never held, and whatever cancels a message at its handover (an ended or stopping run, an inactive target) still cancels the younger one at once.

The handover page also breaks a same-millisecond tie by commit sequence instead of by the hashed record id. Without that, two messages opened by one batch would come back in random order, and the younger one would wait one heartbeat behind itself.

The H4d-b design doc (decision 5, Handover, and the Validation section) states the rule in both languages.

## Why it's needed

Each message has its own ledger row with its own backoff. If the older message's receive fails once (a store fault, a Harness being replaced), the younger one can be handed over, received and run first. The child then runs "actually, don't do X" before "do X". This was item 5 of my independent review comment on #13822, and it is still open on main. Session commands already pass in order (`olderOpenCommand`, #14014); messages did not.

The hold ends exactly where decision 8's settlement hold on the older entry ends. Otherwise a sender that can take no further revision (a declined recovery) would wedge: the older entry's give-up cannot land its own sender step, so its row stays unclassified at the attempt bound. The settlement already stops counting it at that point, but a younger message held at no attempt cost would never reach the bound itself and would hold the child's settlement forever.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```bash
cd packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server
mvn -B test -Dtest='SessionMessageRelayTest,SessionMessageRelayStoreTest,ChildResultRelayTest,ChildResultRelayStoreTest'
```

- `SessionMessageRelayTest`: a message waits behind an older one to the same run, then goes once that one leaves; a child's message to its parent waits the same way; a message is never held behind one to another run; a message to an ended run is still cancelled while an older one is owed.
- `SessionMessageRelayStoreTest`: the older-owed read follows commit order, never the id's spelling; it counts `planned`, `accepting` and `unknown`, skips terminal entries, classified rows, other domains, and rows at the attempt bound (63 still holds, 64 does not); the handover page returns one sender's same-millisecond entries in commit order.
- The full `managed-agent-server` suite: 2759 run, 0 failures outside `ManagedExtensionRecordStoreTest`. That class fails 4 tests (`Session stream is unavailable.`, and a cursor-expired assertion) identically on unmodified main, so they are not from this change. Checkstyle: 0 violations.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no user-visible surface). Mutation check over the new code: removing the hold, holding behind any run, moving the hold ahead of the run-end cancellation, applying it to `to_child` only, dropping `unknown`, dropping the ledger filter, dropping the attempt bound, `<` to `<=` on the sequence, and dropping the sequence tie-break each turn a new test red. The one survivor, dropping the explicit `session_message` domain filter, is equivalent: the self-join on `c.domain = r.domain` already restricts it, as in `olderOpenCommand`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21, Maven 3.9.9, H2 in MySQL mode (the store suites).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a message stuck behind an older one now waits up to that one's give-up instead of overtaking it. That is the point of the change, and the attempt bound keeps it from outliving the settlement's own hold.
- Not validated / out of scope: the MySQL and MariaDB lanes and multi-instance runs. Items 1, 3 and 7 of that comment are documented design rules (decision 8 and the Bounds table) and stay as they are. Item 10 (the settlement's message waits write no reason) is left alone: those waits are bounded now, and the codebase names its no-cost holds in the log rather than on the row.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No schema change.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #13822 (item 5 of the independent review comment on it). Part of #13744.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

session message relay 现在按发送方提交的顺序交接同一 run 的消息。交接一条消息之前,relay 先检查同一发送方是否还有发往同一 child run 的更早消息仍欠交接或回执(`planned`、`accepting` 或 `unknown`,且其 ledger 行既未分类也未超过尝试上限)。如果有,较新的消息在心跳上等待,不消耗尝试次数。发往其他 run 的消息绝不被持有;凡是会在交接时取消消息的情形(run 已结束或正在停止、目标不再活跃),仍会立即取消较新的消息。

H4d-b 设计文档(决策 5 的"交接"与"验证"一节)在两种语言中写明了这一规则。

## 为什么需要

每条消息都有自己的 ledger 行和自己的退避。较早消息的 receive 只要失败一次(store 故障、Harness 被替换),较新的消息就可能先被交接、接收并运行。child 于是先执行"算了,别做 X",再执行"做 X"。这是我在 #13822 上那条独立评审意见的第 5 条,在 main 上仍未解决。session command 已经按顺序传递(`olderOpenCommand`,#14014),消息还没有。

这一持有恰好在决策 8 对较早条目的结算持有结束之处结束。否则,一个无法再接受任何 revision 的发送方(恢复被拒绝)会被楔死:较早条目的放弃无法让它自己的发送方步骤落地,于是其行停在尝试上限、始终未分类。结算在这时已经不再计入它,但一条不消耗尝试次数的较新消息永远到不了上限,会永远持有 child 的结算。

### 如何验证

```bash
cd packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server
mvn -B test -Dtest='SessionMessageRelayTest,SessionMessageRelayStoreTest,ChildResultRelayTest,ChildResultRelayStoreTest'
```

- `SessionMessageRelayTest`:一条消息排在发往同一 run 的更早消息之后等待,那条离开后再走;child 发给父的消息同样等待;绝不排在发往另一 run 的消息之后;更早消息仍欠着时,发往已结束 run 的消息照样被取消。
- `SessionMessageRelayStoreTest`:更早欠交消息的读取按提交顺序,不按 id 的拼写;计入 `planned`、`accepting` 与 `unknown`,跳过终态条目、已分类的行、其他 domain,以及达到尝试上限的行(63 次仍持有,64 次不再持有);交接分页按提交顺序返回同一发送方同一毫秒内的条目。
- 完整的 `managed-agent-server` 套件:运行 2759 个,`ManagedExtensionRecordStoreTest` 之外 0 失败。该类有 4 个测试失败(`Session stream is unavailable.` 与一条 cursor-expired 断言),在未修改的 main 上同样失败,与本改动无关。Checkstyle:0 违规。

### 证据(前后对比)

N/A(没有用户可见的界面)。对新代码做了变异检查:去掉持有、排在任意 run 之后、把持有挪到 run 结束的取消之前、只对 `to_child` 生效、去掉 `unknown`、去掉 ledger 过滤、去掉尝试上限、序号比较 `<` 改为 `<=`、去掉序号排序,每一项都会让某个新测试变红。唯一存活的变异(去掉显式的 `session_message` domain 过滤)是等价的:自连接上的 `c.domain = r.domain` 已经限定了它,与 `olderOpenCommand` 相同。

### 测试平台

| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |

JDK 21,Maven 3.9.9,MySQL 模式的 H2(store 测试套件)。

- 主要风险或取舍:卡在较早消息之后的消息现在会一直等到那条消息放弃,而不是越过它。这正是本改动的目的,尝试上限保证这一等待不会比结算自身的持有更久。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内:MySQL 与 MariaDB 车道,以及多实例运行。#13822 独立评审意见的第 1、3、7 条是已写入文档的设计规则(决策 8 与 Bounds 表),保持不变。第 10 条(结算对消息的等待不写原因)不做:这些等待现在都有上限,而代码库对不消耗尝试的持有一律在日志里命名,不写到行上。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明:无。没有 schema 变更。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): polish files and trim preview resources
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes workspace file names safe to display while preserving the original paths for file operations, and adds a close-preview action that returns to the full-width tree without losing expansion or filtering. Limits Pierre syntax highlighting to common languages and two GitHub themes, and keeps the layout dependency external in the published library.

File labels preserve legal whitespace, and filtering accepts both displayed names and original paths. Development, unit tests and production builds use the same curated resources. Resource budgets reject missing adapters, modified dependency notices survive publishing, and published declarations reject undeclared dependencies.

Existing child-agent Hook tests now observe their execution and settlement promises together and allow ten seconds for asynchronous admission. Each helper captures its own child session to prevent delayed settlement from affecting a later test. This prevents a slow first attempt from leaving an unhandled rejection after a successful retry, without weakening the assertions or changing production behavior.

## Why it's needed

The Files browser currently exposes control characters in tree labels and has no direct way to close only the inline preview. Its highlighter also ships the complete language/theme collection. The original same-baseline measurement at `23f9e986c4` reduced published library JavaScript from 21,531,077 to 14,392,773 uncompressed bytes (33.15% less, excluding the standalone transcript entry).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open Files, expand a folder, and select a source file. Check that source highlighting works in light and dark themes; an unsupported language should remain readable as plain text.
2. Close the preview with the tree visible, then repeat with the tree hidden. Expect a full-width tree, preserved expansion/filtering, focus in the filter, and successful reopening of the same file.
3. Browse names containing control/ANSI/Unicode format characters and names with repeated spaces. Visible and accessible labels should remove invisible controls while preserving legal spaces. Filtering by the displayed label should find all matching files; reads and clipboard paths retain their original names. Files whose cleaned labels coincide must remain distinct.
4. Check the published library and app builds. Both should use the curated highlighter; existing conversation code blocks should retain their highlighting.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual Chromium UI with a **simulated daemon**, captured after the main merge at `fdb4e0d927`. These screenshots show the inline-preview state before closing and the full-width tree afterward; they do not establish real filesystem or Git backend behavior. Screenshots are stored on a separate assets branch and pinned to a fixed commit.

| Inline preview before closing | Full-width tree after closing |
| --- | --- |
| ![Inline source and tree](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/c06a474590463349bf1e15f27237130cfbad76a0/web-shell-files-followups/fixed-preview.png) | ![Expanded tree and restored filter focus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/c06a474590463349bf1e15f27237130cfbad76a0/web-shell-files-followups/fixed-closed-tree.png) |

Validation at `1d10aae114`: complete repository build, typecheck and bundle passed; 73 CLI child-agent tests passed with retries disabled, 45 targeted Web Shell artifact/preview/resource/tree/build tests passed, 22 publish-verifier fixture tests passed, and all 22 Files Chromium browser cases passed. Patch reapplication from pristine pinned files, changed-file lint/formatting and the actual published-package verifier passed. A fresh browser capture confirmed highlighted source, closing/reopening with preserved tree and filter focus, one document request and no forced reload. Two clean full-diff audit passes found no remaining actionable issue. Pierre resource code is 3,820,878 bytes in the app and 3,816,024 bytes in the library, including redirected Shiki subpaths; both are below the 4 MiB budget.

After the review fixes, CI detected a newer main-side lint gate. Merged main without conflicts in `fdb4e0d927`; the entire PR diff against that main is byte-identical to the reviewed diff, and the new CI freshness step passed. On this merged head, full repository lint/build/typecheck/bundle, 73 CLI tests with retries disabled, 45 Web Shell tests and the published-package verifier all passed again; a fresh browser capture also passed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Local Vite development server, Chromium Playwright, simulated daemon. Library size measurements use production builds from the same main baseline and this branch.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: unsupported syntax languages intentionally fall back to plain text. A pinned Pierre Trees patch supplies the display-only formatting hook; remove it when an equivalent upstream API exists.
- Not validated / out of scope: actual filesystem/Git backend operations, Git integration, file editing, and clipboard shell escaping.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public API migration. Existing Shiki 1 consumers keep their highlighter; Pierre uses a separate bundled Shiki 4 entry.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1d10aae114c7cf6202230cf33dec4592e225e45b/docs/design/web-shell-files-followups.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1d10aae114c7cf6202230cf33dec4592e225e45b/docs/design/web-shell-files-followups.zh-CN.md). Both versions are synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #13878. Fixes #13935, including both remaining review items and the optional close-preview action, and corrects layout-dependency license attribution.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这次 PR 做了什么

清洗工作区文件树中名称的显示内容，同时保留文件操作使用的原始路径；增加关闭预览操作，返回全宽文件树并保留展开和筛选状态。将 Pierre 语法高亮限定为常用语言和两套 GitHub 主题，并在发布库中将布局依赖设为 external。

文件标签保留合法空格，筛选同时支持显示名称和原始路径。开发、单元测试和生产构建使用同一套裁剪资源；资源预算会拒绝缺少适配层的构建，依赖修改声明随发布保留，发布声明检查会拒绝未声明的依赖。

现有子代理 Hook 测试现在同时等待执行和结算 Promise，并为异步准入留出十秒等待窗口，避免首次执行较慢时在重试成功后遗留未处理的拒绝。每个 helper 捕获自己的 child session，避免延迟结算污染后续测试。原有断言和生产行为保持不变。

## 为什么需要

当前文件浏览器会在树行中暴露控制字符，也没有仅关闭内联预览的直接操作。高亮器还携带完整的语言和主题集合。原始实现 `23f9e986c4` 相对于同一 main 基线的测量中，发布库的 JavaScript 从 21,531,077 字节降至 14,392,773 字节，未压缩体积减少 33.15%（不包含独立的 transcript 入口）。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 打开“文件”，展开目录并选择源码文件。检查浅色和深色主题下的语法高亮；不支持的语言应回退为可读原文。
2. 在文件树可见时关闭预览，再隐藏文件树后重复。预期恢复全宽文件树、保留展开和筛选状态、焦点回到筛选框，并能重新打开同一文件。
3. 浏览名称含控制字符、ANSI、Unicode 格式字符或连续空格的文件。可见名称及可访问名称应移除不可见控制字符、保留合法空格；按显示名称筛选应找到所有匹配文件，读取和剪贴板路径仍保留原始名称，清洗后同名的文件仍保持不同身份。
4. 检查发布库和应用构建。两者均应使用裁剪后的高亮资源，现有对话代码块的高亮应正常。

### 证据（操作前后）

以上为基于合并 main 后提交 `fdb4e0d927` 捕获的真实 Chromium UI，使用 **模拟 daemon**。左图为关闭前的内联预览，右图为关闭后的全宽文件树；截图不证明真实文件系统或 Git 后端行为。截图保存于独立素材分支，并使用固定 commit 链接。

最新提交 `1d10aae114` 的验证：完整仓库构建、类型检查和 bundle 通过；禁用重试后的 73 项 CLI 子代理测试、45 项相关 Web Shell 产物/预览/资源/目录树/构建测试、22 项发布校验夹具测试，以及全部 22 项 Chromium 文件浏览器测试通过。固定版本依赖从原始文件重新应用补丁、修改文件的 lint/格式检查及真实发布包检查均通过。重新捕获截图的浏览器用例确认源码高亮、关闭/重新打开时保留树状态和筛选焦点，仅一个文档请求且无强制重载。两轮完整 diff 自审未发现遗留的可操作问题。包含重定向 Shiki 子路径后，应用和库的 Pierre 资源代码分别为 3,820,878 和 3,816,024 字节，均低于 4 MiB 预算。

review 修复后，CI 检测到 main 更新了 lint 门禁。已在 `fdb4e0d927` 无冲突合入 main；PR 相对该 main 的完整 diff 与已审阅版本逐字节一致，新一轮 CI 的 freshness 检查已通过。合并后的全仓 lint、构建、类型检查和 bundle、禁用重试的 73 项 CLI 测试、45 项 Web Shell 测试、发布包检查及新截图浏览器用例均再次通过。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境

本地 Vite 开发服务器、Chromium Playwright、模拟 daemon。库体积使用同一 main 基线和本分支的生产构建对比。

## 风险与范围

- 主要取舍：未支持的语法语言有意回退为原文。通过固定版本的 Pierre Trees 补丁提供仅用于显示的格式化接口，待上游具备等价 API 后移除。
- 未验证或范围外：真实文件系统和 Git 后端操作、Git 集成、文件编辑以及剪贴板 shell 转义。
- 兼容性与迁移：无需迁移公共 API。现有 Shiki 1 使用方保持原高亮器，Pierre 使用单独打包的 Shiki 4 入口。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1d10aae114c7cf6202230cf33dec4592e225e45b/docs/design/web-shell-files-followups.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1d10aae114c7cf6202230cf33dec4592e225e45b/docs/design/web-shell-files-followups.zh-CN.md)，两种语言内容已同步。

## 关联事项

#13878 的后续修复，解决 #13935 中两项剩余 review 工作及可选的关闭预览操作，同时修正布局依赖的许可证归属。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): drop the mobile composer's history arrow buttons
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Removes the two one-entry-at-a-time history buttons (↑ / ↓) from the Web Shell touch composer's editing row, together with the composer-core callbacks and the English/Chinese strings that only those buttons used. The rest of the row — the labelled history button shown when a host has not opted into the Add entry, the Shell toggle, keyboard dismiss, and expand — is unchanged, as are the history search panel and every desktop code path.

## Why it's needed

On a phone the editing row's two most prominent leading slots were spent on a low-frequency action, adding a full row of visual noise to the screen where focus matters most, while a strictly better history entry point already existed: the searchable history panel, reachable from the Add drawer and from the labelled history button. The touch restore path behind the arrows was also lossy by design — inline `@file` tag chips are not rebuilt when history is restored into the plain mobile textarea — so the best seat in the mobile UI went to a degraded experience. The issue carries the full rationale and a side-by-side comparison with the Codex mobile composer.

One deviation from the issue text, called out for reviewers: the issue assumed the two navigation callbacks would stay for desktop keyboard navigation. They would not — desktop arrow keys are implemented inline by the editor's `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown` keymap handlers and never called those callbacks, so once the buttons go the callbacks have zero callers. This PR therefore deletes them, including their touch-textarea branches, instead of leaving dead exports; that is what the issue's own "remove the branches if nothing calls them afterwards" instruction reduces to.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open the Web Shell on a touch device (or desktop DevTools with touch emulation) and focus the composer: the editing row above the textarea must no longer contain "Previous input" / "Next input" buttons in either toolbar configuration, with and without the host `addMenu` opt-in. With the Add entry present, tap `+` then "Input history": the search panel opens, lists past inputs, filters as you type, and tapping a match restores that text into the composer and returns focus without submitting. Without the Add opt-in, the editing row still shows the labelled history button and the Shell toggle, and both stay disabled while the composer is disabled. On desktop nothing changes: with a single-line draft, ArrowUp/ArrowDown still walk prompt history and restore the draft saved before browsing.

Automated: `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts` (393 files / 10396 tests passed), `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` (clean), and `npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=mobile-chromium client/e2e/web-shell.composer.mobile.spec.ts` (21 passed). The rewritten Playwright test now asserts that every button in the editing row keeps a 44px touch target and stays inside the viewport at 390px and 240px widths, with no horizontal overflow.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the issue's first screenshot shows the ↑ / ↓ pair occupying the leading slots of the editing row. After: captured locally with the repository's visuals harness (`playwright test --config playwright.visuals.config.ts -g "mobile composer controls"`, Pixel 7 at 390x844) and reviewed by eye — the editing row renders only the keyboard-dismiss and expand controls, right-aligned by the row spacer, with the leading slots empty while the Add entry is configured; no leftover gap, misalignment, or horizontal overflow at 390px or 240px. The captures land in the git-ignored `client/e2e/visuals/output/screenshots/` directory and are not attached here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment

The `packages/web-shell` Vite dev server driven by Playwright, with chromium installed locally via `playwright install chromium`; the `mobile-chromium` project provides Pixel 7 touch emulation.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: mobile users lose one-entry-at-a-time history stepping, leaving the search panel as the only touch recall path. Mitigated by the panel being strictly more capable (full list plus filter) and already touch-ready.
- Not validated / out of scope: real-device iOS/Android keyboard behavior (browser emulation only, per the design doc's open questions); the `mobile-webkit` Playwright project was not run locally because the WebKit browser is not installed here — CI covers it. Desktop editing, daemon routes, and host toolbar opt-ins are untouched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for hosts. No public API or customization surface changed; the removed callbacks were internal to the web-shell client.

Design documentation updated in both languages: [English](docs/design/web-shell/mobile-composer-actions.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/web-shell/mobile-composer-actions.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Closes #14137

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

从 Web Shell 触屏输入框的编辑操作行中移除逐条翻阅输入历史的 ↑ / ↓ 两个按钮，并一并删除只有这两个按钮使用的 composer core 回调与中英文文案。该行其余部分保持不变：宿主未启用 Add 入口时显示的带标签历史按钮、Shell 开关、收起键盘和展开；历史搜索面板与所有桌面端代码路径也保持不变。

## 为什么需要

在手机上，编辑操作行最显眼的两个行首位置被一个低频操作占用，给最需要聚焦的界面增加了整整一行的视觉噪音，而一个明显更好的历史入口其实已经存在：可从 Add 抽屉和带标签历史按钮进入的历史搜索面板。箭头背后的触屏恢复路径本身也是有损的——历史恢复到移动端纯文本 textarea 时不会重建内联 `@file` 标签 chip——因此移动端 UI 最好的位置一直给了一个残血体验。完整理由及与 Codex 移动端输入区的对比见 issue。

有一处与 issue 原文不同的地方，提请评审注意：issue 假设这两个导航回调会保留给桌面端键盘导航。实际上不会——桌面方向键由编辑器的 `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown` keymap 处理函数内联实现，从不调用这两个回调，所以按钮移除后它们将没有任何调用者。本 PR 因此连同其 touch-textarea 分支一起删除这两个回调，而不是留下死代码；这正是 issue 中"若之后没有移动端调用者就移除这些分支"这一指示的最终归约。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在触屏设备（或桌面 DevTools 的触摸模拟）上打开 Web Shell 并聚焦输入框：输入框上方的编辑操作行在两种工具栏配置下（宿主启用与未启用 `addMenu`）都不应再出现 "Previous input" / "Next input" 按钮。存在 Add 入口时，点击 `+` 再点 "Input history"：搜索面板打开、列出历史输入、随输入过滤，点击某条匹配会把该文本恢复进输入框并交还焦点，且不会发送。未启用 Add 时，编辑操作行仍显示带标签历史按钮和 Shell 开关，且输入框禁用时二者同样禁用。桌面端无变化：单行草稿下 ArrowUp/ArrowDown 仍能翻阅历史并恢复开始翻阅前的草稿。

自动化：`cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts`（393 个文件 / 10396 个用例通过）、`npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`（无错误）、`npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=mobile-chromium client/e2e/web-shell.composer.mobile.spec.ts`（21 个通过）。改写后的 Playwright 用例现在断言编辑操作行内每个按钮在 390px 和 240px 宽度下都保持 44px 触控区域并留在视口内，且无横向溢出。

### 证据（前后对比）

改动前：issue 的第一张截图显示 ↑ / ↓ 占据编辑操作行的行首位置。改动后：使用仓库 visuals 夹具本地截图（`playwright test --config playwright.visuals.config.ts -g "mobile composer controls"`，Pixel 7、390x844）并人工查看——编辑操作行只渲染收起键盘和展开两个控件，由行内 spacer 右对齐；在配置了 Add 入口时行首为空；390px 与 240px 下均无残留空隙、错位或横向溢出。截图产物位于被 git 忽略的 `client/e2e/visuals/output/screenshots/` 目录，未在此附上。

### 测试环境

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 运行环境

由 Playwright 驱动 `packages/web-shell` 的 Vite 开发服务器，chromium 通过 `playwright install chromium` 本地安装；`mobile-chromium` 项目提供 Pixel 7 触摸模拟。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：移动端失去逐条翻阅历史的能力，历史搜索面板成为触屏唯一的回看入口。缓解因素是该面板能力更强（完整列表加过滤）且已适配触屏。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：iOS/Android 真机键盘行为（仅浏览器模拟，见设计文档待定问题）；`mobile-webkit` Playwright 项目本地未运行（未安装 WebKit 浏览器），由 CI 覆盖。桌面编辑、daemon 路由与宿主工具栏开关均未触及。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对宿主无影响。未改动任何公开 API 或自定义面；被删除的回调仅存在于 web-shell 客户端内部。

设计文档已同步更新中英文版本：[English](docs/design/web-shell/mobile-composer-actions.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/web-shell/mobile-composer-actions.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #14137

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): keep Artifact guidance out of record_artifact description
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The `record_artifact` tool description no longer tells the model to use the Artifact tool for published interactive HTML. That guidance now lives in the Artifact tool's own description, so the model only sees it when the Artifact tool is registered.

It also corrects a code comment claiming that a `permissions.deny` rule keeps a tool registered. A deny rule without a specifier removes a built-in tool at registration; only a rule with a specifier keeps the tool and rejects matching calls.

## Why it's needed

`record_artifact` is often registered while the Artifact tool is not: in non-interactive runs without managed snapshots, under a shell execution sandbox, when a whole-tool rule removes it (`permissions.deny: ["artifact"]`, `tools.exclude`, `--exclude-tools artifact`, `tools.disabled`), or when a `tools.core` allowlist leaves it out. In each case the `record_artifact` description pointed the model at a tool it does not have.

Embedded hosts that can open workspace files but cannot open published `file://` results remove only the publish tool with a deny rule and keep workspace registration. This stale reference was the remaining gap for them; no new switch is needed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the `record_artifact` and Artifact tool unit tests in the core package. Expected: the `record_artifact` description contains no reference to the Artifact tool, and the Artifact description contains "Use this, not record_artifact, for HTML."
- The rest of both descriptions is unchanged, so the model sees the guidance exactly once whenever both tools are registered.
- That a deny rule without a specifier removes a tool at registration is already covered by the existing permission manager test "deny via display name removes the tool from the registry".

Local results: the two test files pass (83 tests), the repository typecheck passes, and Prettier and ESLint are clean on the changed files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A. This changes model-facing tool description text only; there is no UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only, Node 22.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: when both tools are registered, the "prefer Artifact over record_artifact" guidance now comes from the Artifact description instead of the `record_artifact` description. The model still sees it once.
- Not validated / out of scope: no model-run E2E. The settings documentation still only describes disabling both artifact tools; documenting the deny rule for removing only the publish tool can follow separately.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #14198

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`record_artifact` 的工具说明不再让模型「发布互动 HTML 时使用 Artifact 工具」。这条引导挪到了 Artifact 工具自己的说明里，只有 Artifact 工具已注册时模型才会看到。

同时修正了一段代码注释。原注释说 `permissions.deny` 规则会保留工具注册；实际上，不带限定条件的 deny 规则会让内置工具在注册时就被移除，只有带限定条件的规则才会保留工具并拒绝匹配的调用。

## 为什么需要

`record_artifact` 经常在 Artifact 工具未注册的情况下注册：没有托管快照的非交互运行、开启 shell 执行沙箱、整工具规则移除了它（`permissions.deny: ["artifact"]`、`tools.exclude`、`--exclude-tools artifact`、`tools.disabled`），或 `tools.core` 白名单没有包含它。这些情况下，`record_artifact` 的说明都会把模型引向一个不存在的工具。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 运行 core 包里 `record_artifact` 和 Artifact 工具的单元测试。预期：`record_artifact` 的说明里不再提到 Artifact 工具；Artifact 工具的说明包含 "Use this, not record_artifact, for HTML."
- 两份说明的其余内容不变，两个工具都注册时，模型仍会看到这条引导，且只看到一次。
- 「不带限定条件的 deny 规则会在注册时移除工具」已由现有的权限管理器测试 "deny via display name removes the tool from the registry" 覆盖。

不适用。本次只改模型可见的工具说明文本，没有 UI 变化。

### 测试平台

|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试，Node 22。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：两个工具都注册时，「优先用 Artifact 而不是 record_artifact」的引导改由 Artifact 的说明提供，而不是 `record_artifact` 的说明。模型仍会看到一次。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：没有跑真实模型的 E2E。settings 文档仍只描述同时关闭两个 artifact 工具；「用 deny 规则只移除发布工具」的文档可以另行补充。

prs.title: feat(daemon): support session-targeted Skill and Extension refresh
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Explicit Skill and Extension refresh requests now accept optional `sessionIds` to refresh selected live sessions. Omission preserves full refresh, duplicate IDs refresh once, and an empty array refreshes no sessions. Skill gains independent primary and workspace-qualified refresh endpoints. SDK selection is gated by `workspace_session_refresh` so older daemons cannot silently ignore the filter. Existing Web Shell, Skill toggle, install/delete and automatic reconciliation callers retain their behavior.

## Why it's needed

Extension refresh currently applies to every active session in a workspace, and Skill has no independent REST refresh endpoint. Callers need to update selected sessions without forcing an immediate refresh of every other session or changing the existing activation flows.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Create two live sessions in one trusted workspace and a third in another. Submit explicit Skill and Extension refreshes selecting one session, repeating its ID, passing an empty array and omitting the field. Confirm the refreshed-session counts and live command notifications respectively cover one, one, zero and both sessions. Confirm malformed selections fail with 400 and unknown or foreign-workspace IDs fail with 404 before any session receives a refresh. Check both primary and workspace-qualified endpoints; Extension's synchronous primary response and asynchronous qualified operation remain unchanged.

Confirm a selected Extension refresh does not advance the whole workspace's applied generation, while a full refresh still does. Existing Skill toggles must continue refreshing all sessions in their workspace, including the config toggle's background reconciliation. A new SDK connected to an older daemon must reject selected refresh instead of silently requesting full refresh; existing Extension calls without a selection must retain their request behavior.

Local validation: build, typecheck, bundle, focused ESLint/Prettier, 2,067 relevant unit tests, two clean self-audit passes and an independent full-diff review with no findings. Real daemon HTTP/ACP/SSE verification passed 50 requests across two workspaces; a separate comment records the E2E results.

The real-daemon capabilities integration check also passed after its fixed baseline list was updated for the new capability.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The global CLI baseline (`qwen` 0.22.0) returned 404 for the two Skill refresh endpoints. Extension requests selecting one session or passing an empty array refreshed both sessions and notified both. The local implementation refreshes only the selected session, refreshes none for an empty array, and preserves full refresh when the field is omitted. No visual layout changes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js 26.7.0, locked pnpm 11.24.0, a local bundle running authenticated loopback HTTP with real ACP children and live SSE observers. No model prompt or model API request was issued.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: selection controls immediate session refresh and command notifications. Shared channel caches can change, and existing automatic reconciliation may refresh other sessions later. A selected Extension refresh therefore does not certify whole-workspace generation convergence.
- Not validated / out of scope: browser UI interaction, live untrusted-workspace rejection and alternate execution engines within one live runtime were not exercised in E2E; related trust, engine-routing, generation and SDK contracts have unit coverage. This PR does not change toggle request bodies, Web Shell callers or automatic reconciliation behavior.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive request field, capability and Skill endpoints. Omission retains existing Extension behavior; SDK callers check `workspace_session_refresh` before sending a selection so older daemons cannot discard it.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/a634a00a850247b73914560b3b26d53021b3c344/docs/design/session-targeted-refresh.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/a634a00a850247b73914560b3b26d53021b3c344/docs/design/session-targeted-refresh.zh-CN.md), complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Related approach: #10991. No issue is closed by this PR.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

显式 Skill 和 Extension 刷新请求现在接受可选 `sessionIds`，可只刷新指定的活动会话。省略字段时保持全量刷新，重复 ID 只刷新一次，空数组不刷新任何会话。Skill 新增独立的 primary 和 workspace-qualified 刷新接口。SDK 通过 `workspace_session_refresh` capability 检查会话选择能力，避免旧 daemon 静默忽略过滤条件。现有 Web Shell、Skill 启停、安装/删除和自动协调调用方的行为保持不变。

## 为什么需要

Extension 刷新目前会应用到 workspace 的全部活动会话，Skill 则没有独立 REST 刷新接口。调用方需要更新选定会话，同时避免立即刷新其他所有会话，也不改变现有启停流程。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

在一个可信 workspace 中创建两个活动会话，在另一个 workspace 中创建第三个会话。分别向 Skill 和 Extension 显式刷新接口提交单个会话、重复 ID、空数组和省略字段的请求。确认刷新计数与实时命令通知分别覆盖一个、一个、零个和两个会话。确认不合法的选择返回 400，未知或属于其他 workspace 的 ID 在任何会话收到刷新前返回 404。验证 primary 和 workspace-qualified 两组接口；Extension 的 primary 同步响应和 qualified 异步 operation 保持不变。

确认指定会话的 Extension 刷新不推进整个 workspace 的 applied generation，而全量刷新仍然推进。现有 Skill 启停必须继续刷新其 workspace 的全部会话，包括 config 启停后的后台协调。新 SDK 连接旧 daemon 时，应拒绝指定会话的刷新，而不是静默请求全量刷新；不指定会话的现有 Extension 调用应保持原有请求行为。

本地验证：build、typecheck、bundle、定向 ESLint/Prettier、2,067 项相关单元测试、两次干净的自审，以及完整 diff 的独立审查（无发现）。真实 daemon HTTP/ACP/SSE 在两个 workspace 中验证了 50 个请求，全部通过；另发评论记录 E2E 结果。

真实 daemon 的 capabilities 定向集成测试也已通过，固定基线列表已同步新增 capability。

### 前后证据

全局 CLI 基线（`qwen` 0.22.0）对两个 Skill 刷新接口返回 404。Extension 请求指定一个会话或传入空数组时，仍刷新并通知两个会话。本地实现只刷新选中的会话，空数组不刷新，省略字段时保持全量刷新。没有视觉布局改动。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  | N/A  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node.js 26.7.0、锁定的 pnpm 11.24.0；本地 bundle 在认证的 loopback HTTP 上运行，使用真实 ACP child 和实时 SSE observer。未发起模型 prompt 或模型 API 请求。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：选择条件控制立即执行的会话刷新和命令通知。共享 channel 缓存可能改变，现有自动协调之后仍可能刷新其他会话，因此指定会话的 Extension 刷新不能证明整个 workspace 的 generation 已收敛。
- 未验证或不在范围内：E2E 未操作浏览器 UI、未验证真实 untrusted workspace 拒绝，也未在同一真实 runtime 内切换 execution engine；相关 trust、engine 路由、generation 和 SDK 契约已有单元测试覆盖。本 PR 不改变启停请求体、Web Shell 调用方或自动协调行为。
- Breaking change / 迁移说明：新增可选请求字段、capability 和 Skill 接口。省略字段时保留现有 Extension 行为；SDK 在发送指定会话的刷新前检查 `workspace_session_refresh`，避免旧 daemon 丢弃过滤条件。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/a634a00a850247b73914560b3b26d53021b3c344/docs/design/session-targeted-refresh.md) 和 [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/a634a00a850247b73914560b3b26d53021b3c344/docs/design/session-targeted-refresh.zh-CN.md)，两版完整且同步。

## 关联 Issue

相关思路：#10991。本 PR 不关闭任何 issue。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): add file-tree deletion with confirmation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds **Delete** to regular-file context menus in the Files panel. A second confirmation shows the absolute workspace file path and warns that deletion is permanent. Successful deletion removes the row and its active preview while preserving other expanded folders; failures stay visible for retry.

Deletion is authenticated and restricted to the selected trusted local workspace. Unsupported workspaces do not fall back to the primary workspace.

## Why it's needed

The Files panel already supports browsing, previews, references, path copying and downloads. Users currently need another tool to remove an unwanted file.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open Files in a trusted local workspace and right-click a regular file. Expect **Delete** (中文“删除”) in the menu.
2. Choose Delete. Expect the absolute workspace file path and an irreversible-deletion warning, with Cancel initially focused. Cancel or Escape must leave the file intact and restore focus to the active tree row.
3. Confirm deletion. While pending, cancellation and repeated submission are disabled. On success, the file disappears and its active preview closes; other expanded directories remain expanded and focus returns to an active tree row.
4. Verify that a failed request keeps the file and offers retry. Directories, symlinks, SSH workspaces and daemons without the required capabilities must not offer deletion. Deleting from a secondary workspace must preserve a same-named file in the primary workspace.

### Evidence (Before & After)

These are actual browser captures using a **simulated daemon**. They verify the absolute confirmation path and post-delete tree state; actual disk deletion and workspace isolation were verified separately against a real bundled daemon.

| Before: no delete action | After: Delete menu action |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before context menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/de0264b090192b2b5905612cf8266fe10b73f921/web-shell-file-delete/before.png) | ![Delete action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/de0264b090192b2b5905612cf8266fe10b73f921/web-shell-file-delete/menu.png) |

| Irreversible confirmation | Success: row removed, another folder remains expanded |
| --- | --- |
| ![Confirmation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/de0264b090192b2b5905612cf8266fe10b73f921/web-shell-file-delete/confirmation.png) | ![Completed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/de0264b090192b2b5905612cf8266fe10b73f921/web-shell-file-delete/completed.png) |

Images are pinned to an immutable commit on a separate fork assets branch and are not part of the implementation branch.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.14.0; Playwright Chromium with a simulated daemon for browser tests; real bundled daemon with isolated configuration and primary, secondary and untrusted fixture workspaces for disk assertions. Build, typecheck, bundle, lint/format, 381 focused unit tests and 23 Files browser tests passed. The current bundle also passed an isolated real-daemon deletion/isolation and missing-file smoke test. A separate comment contains the E2E report.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: deletion is permanent. Portable path-based unlink cannot make replacement of a parent directory by an external process fully atomic; canonical-parent checks retain the existing filesystem mutation boundary model.
- Not validated / out of scope: directory, symlink and SSH deletion; Windows/Linux execution; the remaining non-atomic race with uncooperative external processes. Deterministic parent-replacement guards, canonical path locking and same-name workspace isolation are covered by committed regression tests.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The action is gated on advertised capabilities and workspace ownership.
- Synchronized design: [English](docs/design/web-shell-file-delete.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/web-shell-file-delete.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

在 Files 面板的普通文件右键菜单中添加“删除”。二次确认显示工作区文件绝对路径，并明确提示删除后不可恢复。成功后移除文件条目和对应的当前预览，保留其他目录的展开状态；失败提示保留并支持重试。

删除经过鉴权，并限定在选定的可信本地工作区。不支持的工作区不会回退到主工作区。

## 为什么需要

Files 面板已有浏览、预览、引用、复制路径和下载功能。用户目前仍需借助其他工具删除不需要的文件。

## 评审者验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 打开可信本地工作区的 Files 面板，右键普通文件，菜单应显示“删除”（英文 Delete）。

4. 验证失败请求保留文件并支持重试。目录、符号链接、SSH 工作区和缺少必要能力的 daemon 不应显示删除。删除次工作区文件时，主工作区同名文件应保持完整。

### 证据（改动前后）

以下为使用**模拟 daemon** 的实际浏览器截图，确认绝对路径展示和删除后的树状态，只用于验证 UI 状态。实际磁盘删除和工作区隔离另由真实打包 daemon 验证。

| 不可恢复二次确认 | 成功：文件移除，其他目录仍展开 |
| --- | --- |
| ![二次确认](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/de0264b090192b2b5905612cf8266fe10b73f921/web-shell-file-delete/confirmation.png) | ![删除完成](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/de0264b090192b2b5905612cf8266fe10b73f921/web-shell-file-delete/completed.png) |

图片固定到 fork 独立素材分支的不可变 commit，不进入实现分支。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境

Node.js 22.14.0；浏览器测试使用 Playwright Chromium 和模拟 daemon；磁盘断言使用真实打包 daemon，配置及主、次、不可信工作区测试文件均隔离。构建、类型检查、打包、lint/格式、381项定向单测及23项Files浏览器测试均通过。当前bundle另通过隔离真实daemon的删除隔离及文件缺失烟测。E2E 报告另附评论。

- 主要风险或取舍：永久删除。可移植的路径 unlink 无法让外部进程替换父目录完全原子化；规范父目录检查沿用既有文件系统变更边界模型。
