prs.title: feat(web-shell): upload files by dropping into the file tree
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds local file uploads by dragging files into the Files tree. Dropping onto a folder uploads into that folder, dropping onto a file uses its parent folder, and dropping onto sidebar whitespace uses the workspace root. A three-pixel progress bar stays at the bottom of the tree while uploads are pending and disappears when they finish. When the tree is collapsed, active progress remains at the Files panel bottom and errors stay visible above the preview. Current-queue progress survives success-notice expiry and recent successes never inflate a new queue. Successful files appear without resetting the current expansion or preview; failures remain visible and can be dismissed.

## Why it's needed

The file tree already provides workspace browsing, but users must switch back to the composer to upload local files. Uploading directly into a visible folder keeps that action in the place where users are managing their workspace files.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Open Files in a trusted workspace with upload support. Drop several files into the blank tree area, then onto a collapsed or expanded folder. Confirm the files appear at the root or chosen folder, with a thin bottom progress bar during upload and no bar after completion.
- Open a nested file preview and drop another file onto that file row. Confirm it uploads into the same folder and preserves the existing preview and tree expansion. Existing filenames should produce a newly numbered filename without replacing existing content.
- Refresh during a pending nested upload, let the upload complete before the refreshed listing, and drop another file onto the restored folder. Both uploads should stay in that folder.
- Keep a later upload pending after the first file finishes: progress should remain stable when the first success notice expires. A subsequent queue should start fresh while recent success notices still exist. Collapse the file tree during upload and after a failure: progress and dismissible errors should remain visible.
- Confirm upload failures remain visible until dismissed. Dragging local directories or text should not create files; host-disabled or unavailable upload support should prevent upload. File drag events reaching the Files DOM should be canceled, including the preview wrapper and toolbar; text drag events should remain untouched.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Browser screenshots use the actual Web Shell/Pierre tree with a **simulated daemon**. They demonstrate rendered UI and observed upload request destinations/bytes; they do not verify real filesystem or Git operations. The progress screenshot shows a two-file queue after one confirmed upload. Separate real-daemon validation is reported in the E2E comment.

| Before dropping files | Uploading: bottom progress | Completed: root and nested files |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![Before upload](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/446c540e7d0ab7d0e38e858855ecbfaf4a0c2556/before.png) | ![Upload progress](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/446c540e7d0ab7d0e38e858855ecbfaf4a0c2556/progress.png) | ![Completed uploads](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/446c540e7d0ab7d0e38e858855ecbfaf4a0c2556/completed.png) |

| Tree collapsed: active progress | Tree collapsed: dismissible error |
| --- | --- |
| ![Collapsed upload progress](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/446c540e7d0ab7d0e38e858855ecbfaf4a0c2556/collapsed-progress.png) | ![Collapsed upload error](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/446c540e7d0ab7d0e38e858855ecbfaf4a0c2556/collapsed-error.png) |

The same simulated-daemon E2E run captured these collapsed states. Cancelable synthetic drag events verify `defaultPrevented`; native OS navigation and events inside embedded preview iframe documents were not tested.

Local validation passed: full build, typecheck and bundle; 152 focused unit tests; all 26 Files Chromium browser tests; changed-file ESLint and Prettier. Two clean full-diff self-audit passes and independent review have no unresolved findings. Real-daemon checks confirmed secondary-workspace binary bytes, collision naming without overwrite, zero-byte files, and rejection of an unknown workspace without primary fallback.

CI gate refresh: merged main `415925cbda` in `9316fb23f9ea759bd271af4847ea48ae711f54d9` after the freshness guard rejected the older CI workflow. The merge was conflict-free; build, typecheck, bundle, 152 focused Web Shell units, all 26 Files browser cases and the two replay setup cases pass again.

CI follow-up: two inherited Hosted Harness replay setup polls now allow 10 seconds for fsync-backed settlement, matching #14107, with all assertions preserved. A controlled 100ms delay before each actual fixture fsync reproduced both original failures; the identical experiment and the normal-I/O rerun both pass after the change. Before the main refresh, the complete file passed 460/460 with CI’s `--retry=2` configuration. Full build, typecheck, bundle and changed-file lint/format checks pass. A truly stuck setup can now take up to 10 seconds to fail these two tests.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Node 22, Chromium |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Isolated worktree based on main at `415925cbda`; Vite browser E2E with simulated daemon, plus an isolated local bundled daemon for filesystem checks. No model calls are needed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: native drag targeting crosses Pierre's shadow DOM; browser coverage includes collapsed folders, file rows, and overlapping refresh/upload completion.
- Not validated / out of scope: recursive local folder upload, a new manual cancel control, native OS file-drop navigation, embedded iframe drop handling, and Windows/Linux runtime checks. Cancellation cannot recall a file already published by the existing daemon endpoint.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Uploads reuse the existing trusted workspace upload endpoint, capability checks, size/batch limits, and collision naming. There are no backend, SDK, dependency, or composer behavior changes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/9316fb23f9ea759bd271af4847ea48ae711f54d9/docs/design/web-shell-file-tree-upload.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/9316fb23f9ea759bd271af4847ea48ae711f54d9/docs/design/web-shell-file-tree-upload.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

None.

prs.title: fix(core): surface the provider request id on bodyless API errors
prs.body:
# Pull Request

## What this PR does

Surfaces the provider request id on the user-facing API error line, so a bodyless provider rejection is traceable.

Before: `[API Error: 400 status code (no body)]`
After: `[API Error: 400 status code (no body) (request_id: a30a1854-1925-4da8-8803-73fee2865116)]`

The id is not new information — openai-node already stamps `x-request-id` onto every `APIError`'s `headers`. It was being discarded in `Turn.run`'s catch block, which builds a `StructuredError` from `getErrorMessage()` / `getErrorStatus()` and throws the original `Error` away. Six of the seven `parseAndFormatApiError` call sites pass a `StructuredError` or an already-flattened string, so no formatter-only change could ever reach the id. This PR resolves it upstream while the `Error` is still whole:

- `StructuredError` gains an optional `requestId`, populated in `Turn.run`'s catch from the **raw** caught error, before `toFriendlyError()` can substitute an `Error` that no longer carries `.headers`.
- New `resolveApiErrorRequestId()` reads either that resolved field or a live error's headers, reusing `retryPolicy.getHeaderValue` (now exported) so both a real `Headers` instance and a plain record work.
- `parseAndFormatApiError` appends ` (request_id: ...)` **inside** the closing bracket, and skips the suffix when the message already embeds the id (the Responses API error paths print it themselves, so the suffix would repeat it).

Note the suffix is not limited to the bodyless case in the title: it lands on any structured or live error with a resolvable id (e.g. `[API Error: API key not valid… (Status: INVALID_ARGUMENT) (request_id: …)]`), which also changes the error text inside `--output-format json` for errors carrying an id. That broader behavior is deliberate — the bodyless case is just where the id was completely invisible.

## Why it's needed

Reported in #14115. A strict OpenAI-compatible backend (vLLM/SGLang-backed, e.g. TheHive AI) rejects a request with a 400 whose body openai-node 5.11.0 fails to capture, so the CLI shows only `400 status code (no body)`. The user has nothing to quote to their provider, which makes every such rejection undiagnosable — and the related request-shape issues (#14112, #12878, #13807, #13853) all get harder to triage as a result.

Two details that are easy to get wrong, both covered here:

- **Bracket access silently fails.** `APIError.headers` is a genuine `Headers` instance, which has no own enumerable properties, so `error.headers['x-request-id']` reads `undefined`. That trap is what produced the misleading `headers: {}` inspect artifact in the issue thread. Reusing `getHeaderValue` handles `.get()` and plain records (case-insensitively).
- **Placement matters for idempotency.** `isAlreadyFormatted()` keys off `endsWith(']')`. A suffix *after* the closing bracket would defeat that guard and risk `[API Error: [API Error: ...]]` on the second pass through `cli/src/utils/errors.ts`. Putting it inside the bracket keeps the guard working with no change to it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The tests were written first and confirmed red on unmodified `91385884eb` (fresh `origin/main`):

```
× parseAndFormatApiError > request id surfacing > appends an already-resolved StructuredError.requestId
  → expected '[API Error: 400 status code (no body)]' to be '[API Error: 400 status code (no body) (request_id: …)]'
× parseAndFormatApiError > request id surfacing > reads x-request-id off a live error carrying a real Headers instance
× parseAndFormatApiError > request id surfacing > reads x-request-id off a live error carrying a plain header record
× parseAndFormatApiError > request id surfacing > reads X-Request-Id off a live error carrying a plain header record
× parseAndFormatApiError > request id surfacing > keeps the 429 quota guidance after the request id
× parseAndFormatApiError > request id surfacing > bounds an over-long provider-supplied request id
× Turn > run > request id on the Error event > carries x-request-id from a real Headers instance
× Turn > run > request id on the Error event > carries x-request-id from a plain header record
```

The `turn.test.ts` cases are the load-bearing ones: they drive `sendMessageStream`'s rejection path and assert the yielded `LlmEventType.Error` value carries the id. A formatter-only fix passes the `errorParsing` cases and still shows nothing in the TUI, which is why the end-to-end assertion exists.

After the fix:

```
 ✓ src/utils/retryPolicy.test.ts (20 tests) 16ms
 ✓ src/utils/errorParsing.test.ts (35 tests) 13ms
 ✓ src/core/turn.test.ts (50 tests) 40ms

 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  105 passed (105)
```

Both header shapes are covered end to end (real `Headers` and plain record, plus `x-request-id` / `X-Request-Id` casing on the record path, since `Headers.get()` is case-insensitive but a record is not). Regression vectors explicitly covered: the `endsWith(']')` idempotency guard (no double-wrap), the existing 429 quota suffix still appending after the id, and no doubled id on the Responses API paths that already embed it. Nothing asserts on `util.inspect` output of a `Headers` object.

Reproduce locally:

```
cd packages/core
node ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run \
  src/utils/errorParsing.test.ts src/core/turn.test.ts src/utils/retryPolicy.test.ts \
  --coverage.enabled=false
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

```
Before: [API Error: 400 status code (no body)]
After:  [API Error: 400 status code (no body) (request_id: a30a1854-1925-4da8-8803-73fee2865116)]
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment

Unit tests only (Linux, Node v24.19.0). No live-provider run — the reporter offered to test a patch against their endpoint.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `requestId` is appended to a user-visible string. It is bounded to 128 chars (following the bounded-excerpt precedent in `responses-http-error.ts`) so a misconfigured or hostile `x-request-id` cannot spill an arbitrary-length string into the error line. ASCII only — no em dash — because the reporter is on Windows 11 where console encoding is a real hazard.
- Not validated / out of scope: **the raw `errorResponse` body (layer 2 of the issue) is deliberately not added.** The reporter proved with a fetch-wrapper probe that the 435-byte JSON body reaches fetch but is lost *inside* openai-node 5.11.0 — `errorResponse` is `undefined` and the SDK message is literally `"400 status code (no body)"`. An `errorResponse` field would therefore render empty for exactly the backends in scope, so it needs an upstream openai-node fix first. Also untouched: `getRequestId` in `openaiContentGenerator/errorHandler.ts`, which already works — the reporter's own captured `OPENAI_ERROR` record contained `requestId: 'f423f517-…'`. No fallback is added for `APIConnectionError`, which genuinely arrives without headers.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `StructuredError.requestId` is optional and conditionally spread, so the field is absent (not `undefined`-valued) when no id exists and existing `toEqual` assertions on that shape are unaffected. `retryPolicy.getHeaderValue` changed from module-private to exported with no behavior change; it is not re-exported from the package barrel.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14115

## 中文说明

本 PR 在用户可见的 API 错误行上显示 provider 的 request id，使无 body 的 provider 拒绝可追溯。修复前 CLI 只显示 `400 status code (no body)`，用户没有任何可以提供给 provider 排查的信息；修复后显示 `[API Error: 400 status code (no body) (request_id: …)]`。

实现方式：`Turn.run` 的 catch 块在原始 `Error`（还带有 `.headers`）被丢弃之前解析 `x-request-id`，存入 `StructuredError.requestId`；formatter 在闭合中括号内追加该 id（保持幂等保护有效），若消息本身已内嵌该 id 则跳过后缀避免重复打印。同时补齐模板要求的中文说明区块，并在描述中明确：后缀不限于 bodyless 场景，对所有能解析出 id 的错误生效，`--output-format json` 中带 id 错误的文本也随之变化。

prs.title: ci: run Java and Desktop checks daily or on demand
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Move the complete Java check suite and Desktop Shell builds out of pull-request execution. Run Java checks daily at 19:47 UTC (03:47 Asia/Shanghai). Run Desktop Shell checks alongside the existing Desktop packaging dry run daily at 16:00 UTC (00:00 Asia/Shanghai), retaining daily packaging runs. Both workflows retain manual dispatch for earlier validation of a selected ref.

## Why it's needed

The Java workflow's broad path filters expand a single PR update into ten checks, including the compatibility matrix, database integration, process fault gates, RocketMQ and daemon E2E. Desktop Shell also registers two platform jobs in ordinary PR CI before deciding whether the crate changed. A daily batch plus manual validation avoids paying that setup cost on every PR update, without adding a scheduling script or removing the test suites.

Ordinary PR quality checks and release workflows keep their existing triggers. The lightweight Flyway scan stays on PR and main-push CI, and the contract-version guard stays on PRs that change the contract document, in the existing lint job before dependency installation. Heavy Java checks intentionally stop running on both PR updates and main/release pushes to reduce runner contention; daily checks and manual dispatch cover that suite. The Desktop Shell job keeps its Bash shell explicitly when moved, including on Windows, and no longer depends on the PR classifier. Daily Java and Desktop failures on main use the existing failure-issue workflow: identical failures update an existing issue, and new failures create an issue routed to the autofix bot.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- A normal PR update should launch neither the Java workflow nor the Desktop Shell matrix.
- Manual Java dispatch should run the complete suite against the selected workflow branch.
- Manual Desktop dispatch should run both the packaging dry run and the Linux/Windows shell checks against the supplied Qwen Code ref.
- The daily Java and Desktop schedules should validate the default branch. Existing daily macOS/Windows CLI checks should retain their schedule.
- A failed scheduled Java or Desktop run on main should enter the existing issue-deduplication and autofix route. Runs on other branches should not file main-regression issues.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Configuration inspection: Java previously ran on matching PRs and main/release pushes; Desktop Shell lived in PR CI; Desktop packaging ran daily. Java and Desktop now run daily or by manual dispatch. No local tests, builds or workflow runs were executed. No CI monitoring was performed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | ⚠️ Not run |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not run |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not run |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — workflow configuration only.

## Risk & Scope

- Java and Desktop regressions can be detected at the next daily run after merging; manual dispatch provides an earlier check when needed.
- Scheduled execution becomes active after this change reaches the default branch. Release validation remains unchanged.
- This changes execution cadence and failure reporting in four workflows and updates three workflow regression test files to match the moved jobs and preserve lightweight guards; it does not change application code. Actual scheduled execution and automatic issue creation were not exercised.

## Linked Issues

Related to #14178. This PR separates the CI cadence policy from that PR's failure repairs.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 修改内容

把 Java 全套检查和 Desktop Shell 构建移出 PR 执行。Java 每天 UTC 19:47（北京时间 03:47）运行。Desktop Shell 与已有 Desktop 完整打包 dry run 合并为同一入口，每天 UTC 16:00（北京时间 00:00）运行，保留每日打包。两者都保留手动触发，可提前验证指定分支或提交。

### 修改原因

Java 的宽泛路径过滤会把一次 PR 更新展开成十项检查，包括兼容矩阵、数据库集成、进程故障门禁、RocketMQ 和 daemon E2E。Desktop Shell 也会在普通 PR CI 中先注册两个平台任务，再判断是否需要编译。每日集中检查加手动验证，可以避免每次 PR 更新都支付环境准备成本；无需新增调度脚本，也不删除测试套件。

普通 PR 的质量检查和发布流程保留原触发条件。轻量 Flyway 扫描仍在 PR 和 main 推送时运行；契约版本检查仍对修改契约文档的 PR 执行，两者共用现有 lint 任务并在安装依赖前执行。重型 Java 套件有意取消 PR 更新及 main/release 推送触发，减少 runner 争用，改为每日或手动运行。迁移后的 Desktop Shell 显式保留 Bash（包括 Windows），不再依赖 PR 分类任务。main 上每日 Java、Desktop 失败复用已有失败 issue 链路：相同失败更新已有 issue，新失败建 issue 并路由给 autofix bot。

### Reviewer Test Plan

**How to verify：** 普通 PR 更新不应启动 Java workflow 或 Desktop Shell 矩阵；手动 Java 验证应对所选 workflow 分支运行全套检查；手动 Desktop 验证应对指定 Qwen Code ref 运行打包 dry run 和 Linux/Windows Shell 检查；每日任务应验证默认分支。原有每日 macOS/Windows CLI 检查继续按原定时执行。main 上失败的 Java、Desktop 定时运行应进入已有 issue 去重及 autofix 链路；其他分支不创建 main 回归 issue。

**Evidence (Before & After)：** 配置读取确认，原来 Java 在命中路径的 PR 和 main/release 推送时执行，Desktop Shell 属于 PR CI，Desktop 打包每日执行；修改后 Java 和 Desktop 改为每日或手动执行。没有运行本地测试、构建或 workflow，没有监听 CI。

**Tested on：** macOS、Windows、Linux 均未运行验证。

**Environment：** N/A，仅修改 workflow 配置。

### 风险与范围

Java、Desktop 回归可能到合并后的下一次每日运行才被发现；需要提前确认时可手动触发。定时配置进入默认分支后生效，发布验证保持不变。本 PR 修改四个 workflow 的执行时机及失败报告，并更新三份 workflow 回归测试以适配任务迁移、保留轻量检查，不修改业务代码。未实际运行定时任务或自动建 issue。

### 关联

关联 #14178；把 CI 执行时机调整从该 PR 的失败修复中独立出来。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): close post-merge takeover findings from the #13083 review
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR lands the three Critical findings from the [post-merge review on #13083](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13083#pullrequestreview-5383736826) (Hosted Turn takeover / G1 failover), each pinned by a unit witness, plus the findings filed by several follow-up /review rounds (R1–R5) on this PR itself. All three gaps sit on the managed-agent takeover path:

1. **A takeover load left the Session indistinguishable from an idle one.** The load answered 200 and registered the Session while its recovered Turn was still unsettled, yet nothing on the Session marked that Turn as in flight and owned by the client. `/status` reported the exact pair the SDK's settlement check reads as a terminal Turn, a fresh `/prompt` was admitted over the checkpoint the load had just advertised, and a user cancel was a silent no-op while a Runtime Session was held. The Session now records the recovered-but-undriven Turn: `/status` reports it in flight, `/prompt` refuses a fresh Turn over it (logged for oncall), and the continue/cancel routes clear the marker when they drive the Turn to its terminal record — a retryable cancel failure keeps the marker so the coordinator's retry re-drives the same Turn. The marker is deliberately not aliased to the existing active/blocked state, since both refuse the coordinator's own continue/cancel.
2. **A failed continuation reconciliation used to settle the Turn terminally.** The inlined recovered-continuation called the committed-results resume with no error mapping; the follow-up review then established that blocked-for-recovery is worse here: the comment's promised re-drive does not exist (the Session stays registered, and the connector drops its recovery tracking on the 200 admission), and an already-registered Session can never be re-loaded. The shipped shape is therefore the honest terminal one again: a raw escape from the resume — a transient warmup failure, for example — settles the Turn as a terminal error. Two classes still land in the recovery-blocked handler instead: an already-wrapped recovery error, and a retryable Workspace re-acquire refusal (the tool turn rethrows it as-is, and the route wraps it because the checkpoint still holds unconsumed Runtime receipts that a terminal settle would strand). For both, the Turn stays re-drivable and the Session answers `409 hosted_turn_recovery_required` until a takeover re-drives it. A pre-wrapped error is rethrown unwrapped so the block log names the real cause, and a Turn settling without completing drops its pending file-history marker with it — a failing retirement stays owed and is retried by the next settled prompt or by close, so one transient failure can neither brick a Session's file history nor record a completed Turn as an error. Separately, a cancel replay certified while the stop still ran is now recorded on the admission, so a later failure stops waiting for a retry that cannot arrive; a fallible step after the durable checkpoint moved (the marker retirement or the terminal record write) admits loudly — best-effort terminal, recovery-blocked, marker cleared — instead of a permanent identity-mismatch; a refused lease release owes the lease for the next terminal route on the correct runtime-session id, and a Runtime Session the Broker already forgot is treated as handed back so the obligation retires instead of retrying forever. A refused load-resume now logs its reconciliation root cause before answering a bare 503. Finally, every settle exit of the continue and cancel routes answers the Turn's committed sibling calls (a team write, a background launch, a member's board command) through one shared fold before its terminal record, so the record never lands over a call that committed but was never answered.
3. **An unknown execution read had no truthful representation.** The recovery-report status read mapped every `409 runtime_broker_execution_unknown` to "definitively unknown" (#13083 review R2-3). The H2 hooks rewrite on main (#13129) already replaced that fold with a first-class wire state whose only terminal consumer fails closed; this PR owns the terminal arm the Broker marks with `details.terminal` (an ABANDONED record, fenced on loss evidence alone). Such a record now reaches callers as the distinct `abandoned` state — never folded into the not-found sentinel — and the cancellation's stop step accepts it as cancellation-complete without a cancel or a poll that could never observe anything more, while a still-reconcilable unknown keeps failing closed (one shared predicate keeps the pre-cancel skip and the post-cancel poll in lockstep). The passive report keeps its fence too: a fenced record now arrives as known + `{ state: 'abandoned' }` instead of folding into the same unknown the coordinator cannot drive, since only a federated cancellation can retire it. The takeover arms its undriven marker only through the producer's own drivability call (`every outcome known`, and drive restricted to `results_ready`). The user-facing cancel route also refuses a user cancel in the undriven-takeover window with a scoped 409 instead of confirming a cancellation that never happened.

The review history is recorded honestly: R2-3's observed transient-unknown failure was already closed on main by #13129, so this PR's delta on that axis is the terminal arm plus its stop-step handling.

## Why it's needed

Each finding either wedges a shared resource or makes the durable journal lie: a second Turn over the advertised checkpoint pins the recovered Runtime lease on a dead owner; a terminally settled continuation can never be driven again and keeps the checkpoint's receipts unconsumed; a skipped cancel lets a possibly running execution outlive the Turn the journal claims was cancelled; a folded terminal record certifies a stop nobody observed while the Workspace lease is handed away; a certified-then-failed cancel leaves the Session claiming an in-flight Turn that will never settle; and a 204 user cancel claims a stoppage that never occurred. Every fixed branch goes red when its production hunk is reverted (mutation evidence below).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run every touched suite from `packages/cli` (`hosted-file-history.test.ts` is the direct witness for the shared `dropPendingHostedFileHistoryTurn`):

```bash
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts src/serve/hosted-runtime-recovery.test.ts src/serve/hosted-workspace-broker.test.ts src/serve/hosted-file-history.test.ts src/serve/acp-http/transport.test.ts src/serve/hosted-approval-fallback.test.ts src/serve/hosted-hook-session.test.ts src/serve/hosted-harness-session.issue-13328.test.ts
```

What to confirm, one behavior per finding:

- After a takeover load and before any continue/cancel, `GET /session/:id/status` reports the Session in flight and `POST /session/:id/prompt` with a fresh prompt is refused with `409 hosted_turn_active`; the user cancel answers a scoped `409 hosted_turn_recovery_required` in that window (and keeps 204 when idle or driving); after the continuation settles, a fresh prompt is admitted again. (Witness: *reports the undriven recovered Turn as in flight until a terminal route drives it*.)
- When the continuation's reconciliation escapes `resumeCommittedResults()` raw, the route still answers 200 but the Turn settles as a terminal `turn_error` instead of blocking forever, and the Session reads idle and unblocked afterwards. (Witness: *settles a raw reconciliation failure as a terminal error and keeps the Session usable*.)
- A pre-wrapped recovery error reaching the continuation keeps its cause visible in the block log: the logged line contains `Original file history snapshots changed.` rather than the wrapper boilerplate. (Witness: *logs the root cause when the recovered continuation fails pre-wrapped*.)
- A cancel replay that was certified 200 while the stop still ran stops waiting for a retry after failure: `/status` reports `recoveryBlocked: true` with `hasActivePrompt: false`, a user cancel is refused `hosted_turn_recovery_required`, and a fresh prompt gets the truthful code too. (Witness: *reports the failed stop loudly after a replay certified the cancel*.) A failure after the durable checkpoint moved is admitted the same way — loudly, not armed-and-idle. (Witness: *admits the post-settle failure loudly once the checkpoint has moved*.)
- A completion-failing file-history retirement owes the marker and retires it through close: the cold load after detach stays 200; a completed continuation never pays that fallible round trip. (Witnesses: *retires the pending marker through close when the retirement write fails once*, *skips the file-history retirement read on a completed continuation*.)
- A lease release refused after a confirmed stop settles the Turn and owes the lease: the cancel answers 200 with the cancelled terminal record, and the replay's terminal route retries the release instead of the coordinator drowning in 503s and identity mismatches. (Witness: *settles the cancellation and owes the lease when its release is refused*.)
- A 409 carrying `details.terminal` reads as `{ state: 'abandoned' }`, a marker-less 409 as `{ state: 'unknown' }`, a 404 as undefined; through the stop step, abandoned is accepted with no cancel issued while unknown still throws, and an execution fenced abandoned mid-poll still ends the stop. The passive report advertises `unknown` for both kinds. (Witnesses: *distinguishes unknown outcomes from definitive not-found records* at the wire; *accepts a terminally abandoned record as cancellation-complete*, *breaks the terminal poll when an execution is fenced abandoned after the cancel*, and the extended *reports an execution the Broker cannot account for as unknown* at the recovery layer.)
- A cancel whose stop confirmation fails still answers 503, keeps the owned Turn refused, and the coordinator's retry drives the same cancellation to settlement. (Witness: *refuses to settle a cancellation the Broker never confirmed*.)
- A member's board command that committed to its command journal is answered from that journal when a takeover continue settles the Turn without resuming it, on both the compensating exit (the drive's first projection read fails) and the direct exit (the command-wait resume fails raw). (Witness: *answers the committed board command from its journal on …*, two cases; the team-call siblings: *answers the committed sibling when …*.)

Mutation evidence recorded during development, all producing red: reinstating the blanket wrap makes the terminal-settle witness time out with no terminal event; removing the replay-certified failure branch leaves the Session armed and the fresh prompt answered `hosted_turn_active`; rethrowing the refused release turns the owed-lease witness into a 503; removing the terminal discriminator at the broker fails with `expected { state: 'unknown' } to equal { state: 'abandoned' }`; removing the abandoned arm from the stop-step pre-check calls `cancel` once where zero is required; removing it from the poll spins past the test timeout instead of breaking; removing it from the passive fold reports `known` for an abandoned record; dropping `commands` from the shared committed-call fold leaves the member's board call unanswered (`expected [] to have a length of 1`).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change; behavior is exercised by the unit witnesses above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Local run on macOS at `b3f71e16be` (main `415925cb` merged in): 1207/1207 across the eight touched cli suites, plus `tsc --noEmit` and eslint for `packages/cli`. The Linux Test lane result for this head is still pending. Windows is covered by the same suite family.

### Environment (optional)

Local `vitest run`; full `npm run build` and package typecheck green. The previously intermittent `replays a lost cancel admission at its watermark while it runs` was deflaked in this PR (synchronization on the stop step's first status read instead of polling `/status`, whose semantics the takeover change itself alters); 3/3 consecutive full-file runs green locally and green on CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the new `/prompt` refusal, `/status` reporting, and scoped user-cancel refusal apply only in the window between a takeover load and its continue/cancel; the Java coordinator does not poll `/status` in that window (it drives continue directly after load, and its HarnessCoordinator retry scheduler re-drives retryable failures including the 503 the daemon answers for an unconfirmed stop), and every changed branch is pinned by a unit witness.
- The accepted-abandoned cancellation asserts no observed stop; the journal's own wording for that turn is "cancelled with its owner", and the stop-step contract comment now records that the abandoned stop is accepted unproven because the Broker fenced the record permanently on loss evidence. A Session that goes recovery-blocked through the pre-wrapped class or the retryable re-acquire class still has no in-process re-drive, as at base — closing that gap needs the coordinator protocol to grow one, which is deliberately not this PR.
- Not validated / out of scope: the 36 Suggestions from the #13083 post-merge review, tracked in #13187.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the wire contract adds one refusal the takeover design already implied, `/status` becomes truthful where it previously read as terminal, and the user cancel stops promising a stoppage it did not perform in one bounded window.

## Linked Issues

Post-merge review on #13083: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13083#pullrequestreview-5383736826
Deferred Suggestions: #13187

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 落地 [#13083 合后 review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13083#pullrequestreview-5383736826)（Hosted Turn takeover / G1 failover）的三条 Critical 与本 PR 多轮 /review 的后续发现，每条都有单元见证。三个缺口都在托管代理 takeover 路径上：

1. **takeover load 之后的 Session 与空闲会话无法区分。** 恢复出的轮次尚未结算时，load 就已回答 200 并注册 Session，但 Session 上没有任何状态表明该轮次在途且归属于客户端：`/status` 报告的键值对恰好被 SDK 的结算检查读作"轮次已终态"；带新 promptId 的 `/prompt` 会在刚通告的 checkpoint 之上被准入；用户取消在 Runtime Session 仍被持有时静默落空。现在 Session 会记录"已恢复但未驱动"的轮次：`/status` 报告其在途，`/prompt` 拒绝在其上开启新轮次（并落日志给 oncall），continue/cancel 路由把轮次驱动至终态记录时清除标记——可重试的取消失败会保留标记，让协调器的重试重新驱动同一轮次。该标记刻意不复用现有的 active/blocked 状态，因为这两者会拒绝协调器自己的 continue/cancel。
2. **续跑调和失败曾经把轮次结算为终态。** 内联的恢复续跑最初调用已提交结果续跑时没有任何错误映射；后续 review 进一步确认"为恢复而阻塞"在此处更糟：注释所承诺的重驱并不存在（Session 保持注册，协调器在 200 准入时就移除了恢复跟踪），而已注册的 Session 永远无法重新 load。因此交付的形态回归诚实的终态语义：从续跑中原始逃逸的失败（例如瞬态 warmup 失败）把轮次结算为终态 error。仍有两类进入恢复阻塞处理器：已预包装的恢复错误，以及可重试的 Workspace re-acquire 拒绝（工具轮次原样重抛，路由把它包装起来，因为 checkpoint 仍持有未消费的 Runtime 回执，终态结算会把它们永久搁浅）。这两类情况下轮次保持可重驱，Session 回答 `409 hosted_turn_recovery_required`，直到 takeover 重驱。预包装错误原样重抛，使阻塞日志能看到真实原因。另外：仍在运行就被认证通过的 cancel replay 现在会记录在 admission 上，之后失败时不再等待永远不会来的重试，而是把 Session 如实报告为恢复阻塞而非"武装且空闲"；已确认停止后被拒绝的租约释放改为欠账交下一终态路由重试，不再让 503 压在已结算的轮次上（此前会让协调器陷入身份不匹配死循环）。最后，continue 与 cancel 路由的每个结算出口都通过同一个折叠，在终态记录之前回答该轮次已提交的兄弟调用（团队写入、后台启动、成员的看板命令），终态记录不会再落在已提交却未回答的调用之上。
3. **对 unknown 执行读取缺少如实的表达。** 恢复报告的 status 读取曾把所有 `409 runtime_broker_execution_unknown` 映射为"确定性未知"（#13083 review R2-3）。main 上的 H2 hooks 重写（#13129）已把这种折叠替换成一等公民的线上状态，其终态消费者 fail closed；本 PR 拥有的是 Broker 用 `details.terminal` 标记的终态分支（ABANDONED 记录，仅凭丢失证据封闭）。这类记录现在以独立的 `abandoned` 态到达调用方——不再折叠进 not-found 哨兵——取消路径的停止步骤在不发出取消或轮询（两者本就无法再观测到任何东西）的前提下接受它为"取消完成"，仍可调和的 unknown 继续 fail closed；一条共享谓词保证取消前跳过与取消后轮询两臂一致，被动报告仍对两者通告 `unknown`。用户侧取消路由在未驱动 takeover 窗口内对 user cancel 回答 scoped 409，不再确认一次从未发生的取消。

review 历史被如实记录：R2-3 观测到的瞬态 unknown 失败已由 main 上的 #13129 关闭，本 PR 在该轴的贡献是终态分支及其停止步骤处理。

## 为什么需要

每条发现要么钉死共享资源，要么让持久化日志说谎：在已通告的 checkpoint 上再开第二个轮次，会把恢复出的 Runtime 租约钉在已死的属主上；被结算为终态的续跑再也无法驱动，checkpoint 的回执永远无人消费；被跳过的取消会让一个可能仍在运行的执行，比日志声称已取消的轮次活得更久；被折叠的终态记录会把无人观测的停止说成事实，同时把 Workspace 租约递交给下一个获取者；先认证后失败的取消会让 Session 声称有一个永不结算的在途轮次；204 的用户取消会声称一次从未发生的停止。每个修复分支在生产代码被还原时都有见证变红（下文变异证据）。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/cli` 下运行所有受影响的套件（`hosted-file-history.test.ts` 是共享 `dropPendingHostedFileHistoryTurn` 的直接见证）：

```bash
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts src/serve/hosted-runtime-recovery.test.ts src/serve/hosted-workspace-broker.test.ts src/serve/hosted-file-history.test.ts src/serve/acp-http/transport.test.ts src/serve/hosted-approval-fallback.test.ts src/serve/hosted-hook-session.test.ts src/serve/hosted-harness-session.issue-13328.test.ts
```

每条 finding 对应一个待确认行为：

- takeover load 之后、任何 continue/cancel 之前，`GET /session/:id/status` 报告会话在途；带新 promptId 的 `/prompt` 拒绝为 `409 hosted_turn_active`；该窗口内用户取消回答 scoped `409 hosted_turn_recovery_required`（空闲或驱动中仍为 204）；续跑结算后新 prompt 再次被准入。（见证：*reports the undriven recovered Turn as in flight until a terminal route drives it*。）
- 续跑调和以原始形态逃逸出 `resumeCommittedResults()` 时，路由仍回答 200，但轮次结算为终态 `turn_error` 而非永久阻塞，且 Session 事后读作空闲且未阻塞。（见证：*settles a raw reconciliation failure as a terminal error and keeps the Session usable*。）
- 预包装的恢复错误到达续跑路由时，其底层原因仍可在阻塞日志中看到：日志行包含 `Original file history snapshots changed.`，而不是包装器套话。（见证：*logs the root cause when the recovered continuation fails pre-wrapped*。）
- 仍在运行就被认证 200 的 cancel replay，在失败后不再等待重试：`/status` 报告 `recoveryBlocked: true` 与 `hasActivePrompt: false`，新 prompt 被如实地拒绝为 `hosted_turn_recovery_required`。（见证：*reports the failed stop loudly after a replay certified the cancel*。）
- 已确认停止后被拒绝的租约释放改为结算轮次并欠账：取消回答 200 并落已取消终态记录，replay 的终态路由重试该释放，而不是让协调器淹没在 503 与身份不匹配里。（见证：*settles the cancellation and owes the lease when its release is refused*。）
- 带 `details.terminal` 的 409 读作 `{ state: 'abandoned' }`，无标记的 409 读作 `{ state: 'unknown' }`，404 仍为 undefined；经停止步骤，abandoned 被接受且不发出取消，unknown 仍然抛错，取消后被废弃的执行也会让轮询准时结束。被动报告对两类都通告 `unknown`。（见证：wire 层 *distinguishes unknown outcomes from definitive not-found records*；恢复层 *accepts a terminally abandoned record as cancellation-complete*、*breaks the terminal poll when an execution is fenced abandoned after the cancel*，以及扩参后的 *reports an execution the Broker cannot account for as unknown*。）
- 停止确认失败的取消仍回答 503，持有的轮次继续保持拒绝，协调器的重试会把同一次取消驱动到结算。（见证：*refuses to settle a cancellation the Broker never confirmed*。）
- 成员已提交到命令日志的看板命令，在 takeover continue 不续跑就结算轮次时，从该日志得到回答：补偿出口（drive 首次 projection 读取失败）与直接出口（命令等待续跑原始失败）都如此。（见证：*answers the committed board command from its journal on …* 两例；团队调用兄弟：*answers the committed sibling when …*。）

开发过程记录的变异证据（均产生变红）：恢复全量包装让终态结算见证超时且无终态事件；删除 replay 认证后的失败分支会让 Session 处于武装态并把新 prompt 答为 `hosted_turn_active`；还原拒绝释放的重抛会把欠租用例变回 503；去掉 broker 的 terminal 判别得到 `expected { state: 'unknown' } to equal { state: 'abandoned' }`；去掉停止前检查的 abandoned 臂会在要求零次时调用一次 `cancel`；去掉轮询臂会在应结束时自旋至测试超时；去掉被动报告折叠臂会把废弃记录报告为 `known`；从共享的已提交调用折叠中去掉 `commands` 会让成员的看板调用无人回答（`expected [] to have a length of 1`）。

### 前后对照证据

N/A——非 UI 变更，行为由上述单元见证覆盖。

### 已测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

macOS 本地在 `b3f71e16be`（已合入 main `415925cb`）上：八个受影响的 cli 套件 1207/1207，`packages/cli` 的 `tsc --noEmit` 与 eslint 均通过。本 head 的 Linux Test lane 结果待出。Windows 由同族套件覆盖。

### 环境（可选）

本地 `vitest run`；`npm run build` 与包级 typecheck 全绿。此前间歇失败的 `replays a lost cancel admission at its watermark while it runs` 已在 PR 内 deflake（改用停止步骤首次 status 读取做同步，替代语义被 takeover 改动本身改变的 `/status` 轮询）；本地连续 3 轮全文件通过，CI 亦通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：新增的 `/prompt` 拒绝、`/status` 报告与 scoped 用户取消拒绝，只作用于 takeover load 与其 continue/cancel 之间的窗口；Java 协调器在该窗口内不轮询 `/status`（load 后直接驱动 continue，且其 HarnessCoordinator 重试调度器会重驱包括 daemon 为未确认停止所答 503 在内的可重试失败），且每条改动分支都有单元见证钉住。
- 被接受的 abandoned 取消并未断言观测到停止；该轮次落在日志里的措辞是"cancelled with its owner"，停止步骤的契约注释也已写明：该停止未经证明而被接受，因为 Broker 仅凭丢失证据就把该记录永久封闭了。经由预包装类别或可重试 re-acquire 类别进入恢复阻塞的 Session 仍无进程内重驱（与基线一致）——关闭这个缺口需要协调器协议新增一条通道，刻意不在本 PR 内做。
- 未验证/范围外：#13083 合后 review 的 36 条 Suggestions，已在 #13187 跟踪。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无；线上契约只增加了 takeover 设计本就隐含的一个拒绝，`/status` 从"读作终态"变得如实，用户取消在一个有边界的窗口内不再承诺它未执行的停止。

## 关联 Issue

#13083 合后 review：https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13083#pullrequestreview-5383736826
暂缓的 Suggestions：#13187

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): show a reduced header on the new-task page
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The new-task page now shows a reduced built-in header with workspace tools, Local Control when enabled, and multi-host location. The right panel offers Files, Terminal, and Web preview before the first prompt; session actions appear after a session exists. The workspace icon stays visible when the composer does not name the workspace, including single-workspace and host-filtered configurations. Hosts that supply their own header keep the empty page headerless.

The panel follows the composer's selected workspace. Each workspace has its own draft panel state that survives reloads and switching sessions. The first prompt transfers that draft to its new session, preserving tabs, stored order, width, and fullscreen. Deferred tabs become available when their capability arrives. Unrelated session selections never consume a draft, and unresolved workspace ownership keeps the panel toggle unavailable.

Drafts and sessions each retain their latest 20 panel records, so browsing workspaces cannot evict real-session panel state. The existing tab storage format remains compatible. Two shorter panel hints are retained; browser preview tests now identify the entry independently of its translated hint.

## Why it's needed

Users previously had no workspace-tool entry on the new-task page until sending their first prompt. They can now browse files, open a terminal, or prepare a preview while deciding what to ask. The review fixes also prevent tools from opening in a different workspace than the composer names, preserve panel state during session creation, and restore the failing browser preview CI coverage.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open the standalone new-task page. The reduced header should expose configured workspace actions and omit the session title, environment, and usage actions. With a single workspace or a hidden composer workspace action, the header should retain a workspace indicator.
2. Open the right panel. Before a session exists, only Files, Terminal, and Web preview should appear. A host that disables the right-panel header item should not gain an empty header.
3. Open Files, reload, and switch to an existing session and back. The workspace draft should restore. Switch the composer to another workspace: Files and Terminal should belong to that workspace and restore its own draft only.
4. Send the first prompt. The panel should remain open with its tabs, width, and fullscreen state; returning to New task should start with a fresh draft. A previously allocated unrelated session must not consume another draft.
5. Restore a terminal while its capability is unavailable, then let the capability arrive after the first prompt. Its tab should return without a session switch, preserving the saved tab order.
6. Browse drafts while 20 real-session panel records are stored. Those session records should remain available. With no resolved workspace, no panel toggle should be offered.
7. Open Web preview and verify navigation protections still work with the updated hint.

Validation: Root build, bundle, and root typecheck pass. After merging current main, the complete selected unit run passed 1,334 tests. All 12 new regression cases pass and all 12 fail on the original PR head. Chromium browser E2E passes all 7 cases (all 6 live-preview tests plus the new-task flow). Changed-file lint, formatting, and pre-commit checks pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before — the new-task page had no header:

![Before: no new-task header](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/8370b258cca7745828b5834ef0113f3ca0b1bc1f/screenshots/web-shell-new-task-header/before-new-task-page.png)

After — the reduced header retains the workspace indicator when the single-workspace composer has no selector, and the panel offers only workspace tools:

![After: new-task workspace tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/bc9e9a76a9e5baea082a158996dcef390e366484/screenshots/pr-14159/new-task-tools.png)

After — Files remains open when the first prompt creates its session:

![After: Files after first prompt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/bc9e9a76a9e5baea082a158996dcef390e366484/screenshots/pr-14159/first-prompt-files.png)

The new screenshots are captured by a rerunnable browser E2E test against a mock daemon and visually inspected. They demonstrate client UI states; they do not validate real Git or terminal backend operations. Screenshot assets are stored separately from the implementation branch.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ remote CI pending |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22; local Vite and Chromium, using the existing mock-daemon browser harness.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: new-task drafts share the existing tab format but have an independent 20-record retention budget. Only allocation of the first prompt's session adopts the draft; ordinary switches keep normal session restoration.
- Not validated / out of scope: real Git and PTY backend operations, local Windows/Linux execution, and future-facing visibility refactors that do not fix a current defect.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no protocol or tab-format migration; hosts retain their header and panel opt-ins.

Updated design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-new-task-header/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-composer-context-chip-placement.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-new-task-header/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-composer-context-chip-placement.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

新建任务页现在显示精简内置 header，提供工作区工具、启用时的 Local Control 和多主机位置。首条消息前，右侧面板提供文件、终端和网页预览；会话级动作在会话存在后才显示。输入框未标明工作区时，header 保留工作区图标，包括单工作区和宿主过滤工具条的场景。自定义 header 的宿主仍保持空态无 header。

面板跟随输入框所选工作区。每个工作区有独立草稿面板，刷新或切换会话后可恢复。首条消息把草稿迁移到新会话，保留页签、存档顺序、宽度与全屏状态。延迟页签在对应能力到达后恢复。普通会话选择不会消费草稿；工作区归属未确定时不开放面板开关。

草稿与会话各保留最近 20 份面板存档，浏览工作区不会挤掉真实会话面板状态。既有页签存储格式保持兼容。两处简短的面板提示文案保留；浏览器预览测试改为独立于翻译提示文案的方式定位入口。

## 为什么需要

此前用户必须发出首条消息才能在新建任务页进入工作区工具。现在可以先浏览文件、打开终端或准备预览，再决定向助手提出什么需求。本次 review 修复还避免工具在输入框标示之外的工作区中打开，保留会话创建期间的面板状态，并恢复此前失败的网页预览 CI 覆盖。

## 评审人验证计划

1. 打开独立新建任务页，精简 header 应提供已配置的工作区动作，不显示会话标题、环境与用量动作。单工作区或宿主隐藏输入框工作区动作时，header 应保留工作区指示。
2. 打开右侧面板，会话存在前应仅显示文件、终端与网页预览。宿主关闭右面板 header 条目时，不应新增空 header。
3. 打开文件、刷新、切到已有会话再返回，工作区草稿应恢复。把输入框切到另一工作区，文件和终端应属于该工作区，且只恢复它自己的草稿。
4. 发出首条消息，面板应保持打开并保留页签、宽度与全屏。返回新建任务页应是全新草稿。选择之前分配的无关会话不得消费其他草稿。
5. 对应能力不可用时恢复终端，然后在首条消息后让能力到达；无需切换会话，终端页签应恢复且保持存档页签顺序。
6. 已有 20 份真实会话面板存档时浏览草稿，会话存档应继续可用。工作区未确定时不应开放面板开关。
7. 打开网页预览，验证新提示文案下导航防护仍然正常。

验证结果：全仓构建、bundle 与全仓类型检查通过。合入当前主线后，完整定向单测运行通过 1,334 条。12 条新回归用例全部通过，同一组 12 条在原 PR head 上全部失败。Chromium 浏览器 E2E 7/7 通过（全部 6 条网页预览测试，加新建任务流程）。改动文件的 lint、格式和提交前检查通过。

## 前后证据

上方第一张图显示改动前的新建任务页没有 header；第二张图显示精简 header 在单工作区输入框没有选择器时保留工作区指示，右面板只提供工作区工具；第三张图显示首条消息创建会话后文件面板仍打开。新截图来自可重跑的浏览器 E2E 测试，使用模拟 daemon，并经过目视检查；只证明客户端 UI 状态，不验证真实 Git 或终端后端操作。截图素材存放在独立分支，不进入实现分支。

## 测试平台与环境

macOS 本地已验证；Windows 未在本地验证；Linux 远程 CI 待完成。环境为 Node 22、本地 Vite 和 Chromium，使用仓库既有模拟 daemon 浏览器测试设施。

## 风险与范围

- 主要取舍：新任务草稿复用既有页签格式，但有独立的 20 条保留额度。只有首条消息分配新会话时接管草稿；普通切换沿用会话恢复逻辑。
- 未验证或超出范围：真实 Git 和 PTY 后端操作、本地 Windows/Linux 执行，以及不修复现存缺陷的前瞻性可见性重构。
- 破坏性变化与迁移：没有协议或页签格式迁移；保留宿主的 header 和面板配置选择。

设计已同步更新：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-new-task-header/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-composer-context-chip-placement.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-new-task-header/docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-composer-context-chip-placement.zh-CN.md)。关联 Issue：无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(acp): confirm legacy cancellations and clarify interruption notices
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Allow a legacy cancelled turn to resume only after explicit confirmation of its current recorded boundary. This follows merged #13436 and keeps explicit user cancellation blocked. It also distinguishes user cancellation from interruption in live and replayed notices, and removes the actionable recovery banner for a user-stopped task.

Only a valid, uniquely owned timestamp-only cancellation receives a confirmation identity. Missing or stale identities, malformed or ambiguous cancellation boundaries, and any later cancellation evidence cannot authorize execution. The same identity is checked at admission and again before model execution. This reuses the existing recorded turn identities and terminal outcomes; no recovery cache, planner extension, transcript index or migration is introduced.

## Why it's needed

#13436 makes unknown legacy cancellation safe by refusing Continue. Users need a deliberate way to recover eligible old work without allowing an outdated confirmation to restart another task or bypass a later Stop. The UI also needs to reflect the backend decision instead of offering Continue after explicit cancellation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Restore a valid timestamp-only cancellation. Missing or stale confirmation must send no model request; confirming the current boundary must resume once and complete. Reusing the old identity afterward must refuse.
- Explicitly cancel a task, restart and load it. Continue must remain unavailable even if a caller supplies a confirmation identity. A fresh user task must still work.
- Place later cancellation evidence after an otherwise eligible old record. The old confirmation must be unavailable. A completed local command alone must preserve eligibility.
- Restore malformed or ambiguously owned cancellation evidence. It must not become confirmable.
- In WebShell, dismiss the legacy confirmation dialog and verify zero execution; accept it and verify completion and removal of the banner. Check that user-stop and interruption notices remain distinct after reload.
- Check REST, ACP, SDK and stream-json forwarding. Calls without confirmation must retain their original wire shape; ordinary prompt metadata must not spoof trusted continuation.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: main refuses unknown cancellation; cancelled work may still show a misleading Continue banner. After: only a validated current legacy boundary may be explicitly confirmed, user-stopped work stays blocked, and status/notice rendering reflects the cancellation source. Current verification details and limitations are in the separate test-report comment.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | Current focused tests, builds/typechecks, and controlled local verification |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | Not tested locally |

## Risk & Scope

- Optional confirmation identity is additive. SDK callers must distinguish AbortSignal interruption from explicit public Cancel.
- This preserves foreground recovery, not automatic Goal/Cron/notification queue recovery.
- Idle Close after an earlier interruption and other separately tracked attribution decisions remain in #13502. This PR does not close #6710 or #13502 as a whole.
- No production-provider, credentialed channel, physical machine/container crash, migration or release acceptance is claimed.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to merged #13436. Related to #6710, #13478 and #13502.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 接续已合并的 #13436，只为合法、唯一归属的旧时间戳取消记录提供当前边界的显式确认。明确用户取消始终拒绝；缺失、过期确认，损坏或归属不明的取消，以及后到的取消证据，都不能授权执行。准入和模型执行前重复检查同一个确认 ID，不新增恢复缓存、planner 字段、转录索引或迁移。

WebShell 对旧记录显示“确认并继续”；明确用户取消不再显示可操作恢复按钮。实时和重放提示区分用户取消与中断。验收需要证明零误执行、当前确认只恢复一次、新任务不被旧取消阻止，以及过期对话框无法提交。具体运行结果及限制见独立测试评论。

已空闲的中断任务再次 Close 后仍能恢复的问题留在 #13502。本 PR 不整体关闭 #6710 或 #13502，不宣称后台队列、生产模型、真实 channel 或物理机器崩溃已验收。

</details>

prs.title: fix(sdk-java): restore session-root materialization in acquireWriter (#14224)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Restores the session-root materialization that `acquireWriter` lost in 9dacfdbe1a's CSI gap-lock repair. That change replaced the unconditional `ensureSessionRoot` call with `insertSessionRoot` so a freshly created root can skip the CSI index probe — but `ensureSessionRoot` had also been responsible, for a root that already exists, for backfilling the session's `tenant_key`/`session_key`/`session_scope_key` columns and inserting its `SESSION` event-stream row. The session read path joins that stream row and its mapper throws `IllegalStateException("Session stream is unavailable.")` when it is absent, so any managed session whose row predates the writer became unreadable through the task and session APIs.

The fix splits `ensureSessionRoot` so the post-insert half (scope-key backfill plus the `SESSION` event-stream insert) is reusable as `materializeSessionRoot`, and calls it from `acquireWriter` at the exact position the pre-9dacfdbe1a call stood: after the CSI block, before storage binding. The CSI probe skip for fresh roots — the point of 9dacfdbe1a — is preserved unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Main-branch CI is red: the nightly `SDK Java` run on 9dacfdbe1a failed four `ManagedExtensionRecordStoreTest` tests (`aChildAgentTaskCarriesItsCancelAndItsEventsThroughTheStop`, `aWorkflowTaskCarriesItsCancelAndItsEventsThroughTheStop`, `answersCursorExpiredRatherThanAGappedPageWhenTheFloorMoved`, `pagesFreshEventsAgainstTheRealJournal`) in both the MariaDB lane and the Hosted lane, because both run the surefire suite as part of `clean verify`. The failure is deterministic and platform-independent — it reproduces on H2 locally with the identical stack.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Check out this branch, then run the previously failing class against H2 (no database server needed): `mvn -f packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -Dtest=ManagedExtensionRecordStoreTest test` — expect `Tests run: 34, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`. To see the defect, run the same command on main: the four tests above fail with `java.lang.IllegalStateException: Session stream is unavailable.` thrown from the session mapper, because the raw-inserted session row never receives its `SESSION` event-stream row. Also confirm the CSI fix still holds: a fresh root still skips the CSI probe (`createdRoot ? null : lockCsiOriginal(...)` is unchanged), and the restored statements are the same two idempotent, own-key writes `ensureSessionRoot` performed before 9dacfdbe1a, placed after the placement/tenant locks exactly as before.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI change). Before: `ManagedExtensionRecordStoreTest` — 34 run, 1 failure + 3 errors (`Session stream is unavailable.`). After: 34 run, 0 failures, 0 errors; full module surefire suite 2753 run, 0 failures (the single `RuntimeBrokerDefaultOnTest` error is a pre-existing sandbox limitation — missing `/etc/machine-id` — reproduced identically on the unmodified base tree, and is not among the CI failures).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Temurin JDK 21.0.12 + Maven 3.9.9 downloaded to a temp dir; H2 in-memory database via the test class's own `@SpringBootTest` configuration. The MariaDB/MySQL failsafe lanes and Hosted lanes were not run locally (no database server or host-identity files in the sandbox); CI remains the final gate for those.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the restored writes take the session-row write lock in `acquireWriter` again; they sit after the placement and tenant locks (same ordering as `authorizeLifecycle` and as pre-9dacfdbe1a), so no new lock-ordering class is introduced, and both statements are idempotent single-key operations (`UPDATE` by primary key with a `IS NULL` guard, `INSERT IGNORE` on the stream's primary key).
- Not validated / out of scope: the MySQL/MariaDB integration lanes and Hosted process gates run only in CI; the `RuntimeBrokerDefaultOnTest` sandbox failure is pre-existing and untouched by this change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — this restores the materialization contract that existed before 9dacfdbe1a.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14224

<summary>中文说明</summary>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): open workflow agents in the detail panel
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Clicking a dynamic workflow node opens its Agent transcript in the existing right-side panel, including its prompt, tool activity, streamed output, and execution status. This works from the inline workflow card, Tasks dialog, and Workflow page. Repeated clicks reuse the same Agent tab; keyboard activation works too.

Workflow dispatches now publish their actual agent identity at startup and persist the metadata required to resolve their transcripts. The identity remains stable across stall retries, and terminal status is recorded after retry handling completes. Historical runs retain their original chat identity, so opening them from another chat resolves the correct transcript even when the original chat is unloaded. Persisted workspace ownership and trust checks apply without loading the parent chat.

## Why it's needed

Workflow nodes previously only selected an inline dispatch summary. Users could see that an agent was running but could not inspect what it was doing. Most dispatches did not expose their agent identity unless they requested approval, and their transcript files lacked the metadata used by the existing Agent detail resolver.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run a dynamic workflow with multiple agents, then click a running node in the conversation. The right panel should show that agent's prompt, tool calls, and new streamed output. The main conversation must not receive the child-only output.
- Click the same node again: one tab should remain. Activate another completed node with Enter: its own transcript should open. Repeat from the Workflow page or Tasks dialog.
- Queued, cached, or identity-less nodes should retain summary-only selection. Merely focusing a node or receiving a polling update must not open a tab.
- Open a completed run from chat A through chat B’s Workflow History. Its Agent panel should show A’s transcript, including after a daemon restart with A unloaded. Legacy historical records without an owner remain summary-only.
- Confirm regular standalone Agent details retain Stop. Workflow Agent details use the workflow's existing run controls and do not offer an unsupported standalone-agent Stop.

Validation on macOS: repository build, typecheck, and bundle passed; 530 focused core tests, 23 transcript resolver tests, and 201 Web Shell tests passed. The cross-chat history repair additionally passed 291 backend tests, 243 Web Shell tests and 33 build-artifact tests. Three controlled Chrome cases cover inline, Workflow-page and cross-chat History entry, correct parent/agent resolution, child-only streaming for live runs, tab reuse, keyboard activation and missing-identity behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Controlled mock-daemon/model fixture, macOS Chrome, dark theme, 1600 × 1000. Screenshots demonstrate the actual Web Shell UI and isolated child SSE delivery; they are not a live model run. The before capture uses the base workflow component; the after capture uses this implementation.

| Before: node only selects a summary | After: node opens the Agent transcript |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/evidence/workflow-agent-detail-20261014/workflow-agent-detail/before.png) | ![After](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/evidence/workflow-agent-detail-20261014/workflow-agent-detail/workflow-agent-inline.png) |

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local isolated worktree, Node 25.9.0, pnpm 11.24.0. Browser tests use controlled daemon responses and separate child SSE streams; backend tests exercise persisted metadata and transcript resolution independently.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: workflow metadata must preserve parent-session ownership and terminal status across retries. Workflow agents are marked as foreground so ordinary background-task recovery does not resume them independently.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live provider workflow run; older runs without the new identity/metadata are not backfilled. This adds viewing, not independent workflow-child cancellation.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: an optional parentSessionId is added to workflow status and snapshots; no migration is required. Legacy records without that identity remain summary-only. Completed workflow agents can appear in the existing Agents history, consistent with foreground-agent history behavior.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 变更内容

点击 dynamic workflow 节点后，直接在现有右侧面板打开对应 Agent 的执行记录，展示提示词、工具活动、流式输出和状态。聊天中的 workflow 卡片、任务弹窗和 Workflow 页面均支持；重复点击复用标签页，也支持键盘操作。

Workflow 调度现在会在启动时记录真实 Agent 身份，并持久化现有详情查询接口需要的元数据。卡顿重试沿用同一身份，所有重试结束后再记录最终状态。历史运行保存原始聊天身份，从其他聊天打开时仍定位原始日志；原聊天未加载时按持久化 workspace 归属及信任校验读取，不恢复父聊天。

### 原因

此前节点只能切换卡片内的调度摘要，用户无法查看 Agent 具体在做什么。多数调度只有请求审批时才记录 Agent 身份，已有执行日志也缺少详情查询使用的元数据。

### 验证方法

运行包含多个 Agent 的动态工作流，点击运行中的节点，确认右侧展示该 Agent 的提示词、工具调用和新增输出，主会话不会收到仅属于子 Agent 的输出。重复点击不产生重复标签；用 Enter 打开另一个已结束节点，确认显示对应记录。也可从 Workflow 页面和任务弹窗验证。

排队、缓存命中或缺少身份的节点只切换摘要；聚焦或轮询更新不会自动打开标签。普通 Agent 仍保留停止按钮，Workflow Agent 通过工作流已有控制操作，不展示不受支持的独立停止按钮。

macOS 上完整 build、typecheck、bundle 通过；530 项核心测试、23 项日志解析测试、201 项 Web Shell 测试通过。跨聊天历史修复另通过 291 项后端测试、243 项 Web Shell 测试和 33 项构建产物测试。三个 Chrome 用例覆盖聊天、Workflow 页面及跨聊天历史入口、父会话与 Agent 精确关联、实时子会话流式更新、标签复用、键盘操作和缺少身份的节点。

### 前后对比与环境

上方截图使用 macOS Chrome、深色主题、1600 × 1000 视口和受控模拟数据，展示真实 Web Shell 界面及独立子会话 SSE；不是在线模型运行。Before 使用基线 workflow 组件，After 使用本次实现。Windows 和 Linux 未本地验证。

独立 worktree，Node 25.9.0、pnpm 11.24.0；浏览器模拟 daemon 响应，后端另行验证真实文件元数据和日志解析。

### 风险与范围

重点保证父会话归属、重试和终态一致；标记为前台 Agent，避免被普通后台任务恢复机制独立恢复。未执行真实模型工作流，不回填缺少身份或元数据的历史运行，不增加单独取消 workflow 子 Agent 的能力。

Workflow 状态及快照新增可选 parentSessionId 字段，无需迁移；缺少原始聊天身份的旧历史保持仅查看摘要。已结束的 workflow Agent 可能进入现有 Agents 历史列表，与普通前台 Agent 的历史收集行为一致。无关联 issue。

</details>



## Critical review follow-up

Workflow Agent details now record their writer PID and hostname. A foreground workflow sidecar whose same-host writer has exited is shown as failed, with no active prompt or transcript polling. This is a read-only status projection: ordinary agents, legacy sidecars without ownership evidence and sidecars from another host retain their previous behavior.

Historical resolution first preserves a healthy persisted owner. If none exists and the primary runtime is transitioning or blocked, the detail endpoints return the existing retryable 503 with Retry-After: 1 instead of a terminal 404. A healthy secondary workspace still resolves successfully while the primary is unavailable.

Both Critical findings were reproduced before their fixes. Validation: 366 core tests, 28 virtual-session tests, 8 persisted-owner route cases, and the 3 previously failing Hosted tests passed locally; full build, typecheck, bundle, changed-file lint/format and two clean diff reviews passed. Main was merged through 415925cb, including its Hook wait and CI scheduling fixes. The prior MariaDB job timed out before acquiring its host lock; the two Hosted takeover failures did not reproduce locally or in the inspected main runs, so they remain an unconfirmed slow-runner hypothesis pending new-head CI. Other non-blocking suggestions are outside this Critical repair and remain open.

prs.title: chore: adopt qwen-code-checks.xml and fix all checkstyle violations
prs.body:
## Summary

Adopt a dedicated `qwen-code-checks.xml` Checkstyle configuration, based on the [alibaba/fastjson2](https://github.com/alibaba/fastjson2) convention, and clear every violation it reports in the managed-agent-server module, across both main and test sources.

The measured starting point is **1835 violations** on the merge base under this ruleset, counted with the Checkstyle version the build actually resolves and with test sources included. It is now **0**.

## Changes

### Configuration

The new ruleset is a verbatim copy of fastjson2's, renamed to qwen-code's own. It differs from the configuration the sibling modules already use in exactly one respect: import ordering is enabled, requiring the `*`, `javax`, `java` groups to be separated, with static imports at the bottom.

The managed-agent-server build now points at it and checks test sources too, matching fastjson2's practice.

A checkstyle step is added for the same module in the fast matrix job. It was the only module on the new ruleset, yet nothing enforced that ruleset outside the full verify lanes, which need a database and a host lock and have starved before. The goal declares no dependency resolution, so the new step needs no sibling install and costs 740 bytes against a 4096-byte ratchet allowance.

This does not add PR-time feedback, and the description of an earlier revision of this paragraph claimed otherwise. This workflow now triggers only on a daily schedule and on demand; `pull_request` was removed from its triggers when the Java checks moved off the PR path, and no other PR-triggered workflow runs Java checkstyle. What the step does add is enforcement of the ruleset in the fast matrix job rather than only inside the database lanes, so a style regression is caught daily without needing MariaDB or the host lock.

### Source fixes

425 Java files, +4272/-3329. Imports are regrouped and deduplicated, whitespace and blank-line rules are satisfied, braceless control-flow bodies are braced, inline and Allman-style opening braces move to the canonical end-of-line multiline form, indentation is set to the level checkstyle itself reports as expected, multi-statement lines are split, and single-element annotation arrays take the compact form.

Six edits are not purely mechanical, because the ruleset admits no mechanical solution at those points. Each is behaviour-preserving. Three no-op `default` arms are dropped from switch statements: an empty switch-arrow block cannot satisfy both the rule forbidding whitespace inside it and the rule requiring whitespace after the arrow, since the empty-lambda exemption does not cover switch arrows. One switch expression moves out of a call argument into a local, where the parenthesis-padding rule and the whitespace-around rule stop contradicting each other. Two empty loop bodies gain the text that the empty-block rule requires.

## Verification

Every figure below was measured locally against the managed-agent-server module.

- `mvn checkstyle:check` — **BUILD SUCCESS, 0 violations**, from 1835 on the merge base.
- `mvn -DskipTests test-compile` — **BUILD SUCCESS**.
- A parse-only `javac` run over all 919 sources in the Java SDK — **0 syntax errors**.
- A token-level audit against the merge base over all 426 changed Java files, comparing string literals and comments verbatim while ignoring braces and whitespace and comparing imports as sets — **0 unexplained differences**. The six edits named above are the only ones it reports. Its positive controls detect a flipped comparison operator, a deleted statement, and a space pushed into a string literal, so the clean result is not a false negative.
- The full test suite run against a pristine-merge-base control, with alphabetical test order pinned on both trees — **identical totals and an identical set of 810 failing methods**, `diff` empty. The absolute numbers are high because alphabetical order breaks the suite's implicit state dependencies; the point is that both trees agree exactly.

### On the Checkstyle version

The build does not pin an underlying Checkstyle, so the plugin resolves 9.3. The ruleset was copied from a project that targets a newer one, and the two disagree: the same tree scores 803 rather than 776 under 10.23.1, differing on whitespace-after and whitespace-around. Every figure above is therefore measured through Maven, not a locally installed CLI, so it reflects the standard CI enforces.

Bumping the pinned version is deliberately left out of this PR. Checkstyle 10.x needs Java 11 and one existing checkstyle lane runs on exactly Java 11, so the change carries its own risk and deserves its own review.

## Notes

The configuration the sibling modules already use is preserved and still referenced by them. Migrating those three modules would add 104 violations on main sources alone and is out of scope here.

## History

Earlier revisions of this PR described their verification as passing. It had not been run. `mvn checkstyle:check` aborted with a parse exception instead of reporting violations, and `mvn test-compile` failed with 809 `javac` syntax errors module-wide.

Two rewrite passes were at fault. The control-flow pass braced wrapped expression continuations that it mistook for braceless `if` and `for` bodies, breaking ternaries, casts, string concatenations and constructor calls in ternary branches across 90 files; CI showed only 18 of them because `javac` caps its output at 100 errors and the test sources were never reached. The import pass was not anchored at column 0, so it reached inside a Java text block, took the embedded TypeScript import for an unused Java one, and deleted a class declaration, a field and a live import along with it.

@chiga0 caught the first of these in review. Both are repaired, and this description now carries measured numbers rather than asserted ones.

prs.title: test(ci): pin the main-failure watcher's whole job condition
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follow-up to #14227. The main-failure watcher test now pins the `analyze` job's whole `if:` condition exactly, compared as the YAML parser returns it (the `>-` block is already folded to one line, and whitespace inside the `fromJSON` name literals is kept byte for byte). A second assertion parses the schedule arm's name set out of that condition and requires every name to be one of the watched workflows. Without it, an edit that adds a name to the condition and updates the exact pin at the same time would leave that name unable to ever raise the event, and nothing would fail. Before this change it checked three separate fragments of that condition. Two other pins also stop failing on edits that change no behavior: the watched-workflow list is compared as a set, and the EventTransport broker gate only requires that a `schedule` trigger exists. The exact cron stays pinned in one place, `sdk-java-workflow.test.js`. This is a test-only change; no workflow is touched.

## Why it's needed

#14205 split the watcher's condition across several lines, so #14227 replaced the old whole-clause pin with three fragment checks. Any extra disjunct that leaves all three fragments intact still passes. Examples are an appended `|| true` inside the schedule arm or after the event clause, or `&&` flipped to `||` between `head_branch == 'main'` and the event clause. Each of these makes the gate admit pull-request runs. That includes a fork PR opened from a branch named `main`, whose `head_branch` passes both the trigger-level and the job-level branch filters. Such a run then reaches the job that files an `autofix/approved` issue with the bot PAT. The test's own comment says this must never happen. The old pre-#14205 pin also missed the outer `|| true` variant, because it was not anchored at the closing `}}`.

The two other pins were brittle without protecting anything:

- Reordering the `workflow_run.workflows` list failed the test, but `workflow_run` treats the list as a set.
- Changing the SDK Java cron failed both `event-transport-broker-ci.test.js` and `sdk-java-workflow.test.js`, although the broker gate only depends on a schedule existing.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/main-ci-failure-issue-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/event-transport-broker-ci.test.js scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/desktop-isolation.test.js scripts/tests/ci-platform-lanes.test.js`: all six files pass (136 tests).
2. Mutation probe: apply each mutation below to the workflow file, run the four trigger and watcher test files, then restore the file. Compare `main` (415925cbda) with this branch. A green result for a behavior change means the mutation went undetected.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Mutation | main (before) | this PR (after) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| M1 watcher `if`: `\|\| true` appended inside the schedule arm (every event admitted) | **green (missed)** | RED |
| M2 watcher `if`: schedule arm `&&` → `\|\|` | RED | RED |
| M3 watcher `if`: name set gains `"E2E Tests"` | RED | RED |
| M4 watcher `if`: push arm scoped to `'Qwen Code CI'` | RED | RED |

prs.title: fix(web-shell): bound pending edit diffs to nearby context
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Pending and in-progress whole-file edit previews show each change with up to three surrounding lines and file-relative hunk coordinates. Common file ends are trimmed before comparing. Oversized previews explicitly report omission; LF and CRLF final-newline-only edits show a localized notice. Replacement-fragment arguments retain their headerless preview, and supplied patches and completed previews retain their existing behavior.

Diff previews visibly mark invisible characters instead of rendering them as indistinguishable source text. Both raw patches and full-content artifact views use the same visible escapes; the underlying CodeMirror document retains its original bytes. Call details apply their 4,000-character content limit after escaping. Uniform CRLF previews remain clean when their final line is unterminated, while actual ending conversions remain visible.

## Why it's needed

A one-line edit near line 100 of a 200-line file previously rendered 201 rows. Whole-file previews now render nine rows with correct coordinates. This keeps approval readable without changing the permission protocol or tool execution.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Edit line 100 of a 200-line file: the approval dialog and pending/in-progress whole-file card should show lines 97–103 and +1/-1.
- Supply replacement fragments through the edit tool's real arguments: expect the existing headerless preview, without a claim about the fragment's file offset.
- Check a large insertion and distant edits that exceed the preview budget: expect an omitted notice rather than a fabricated whole-file rewrite.
- Add or remove only the final LF or CRLF terminator: expect the localized notice and no +1/-1 badge. Adding/removing a sole blank line and converting LF to CRLF remain real content changes.
- Review a CRLF file without a final newline: a content edit should not add terminator noise.
- Compare real invisible characters with literal escape text and mixed full-content/raw-patch artifact entries: only real characters receive a visible decoration, with matching display in both renderers. CodeMirror retains the original document.
- Expand a call whose escaped output exceeds 4,000 characters: content remains within the bound and a truncation notice appears. Embedded notice-like patch rows remain literal.
- Check supplied patches, completed previews and failed calls: preserve their existing behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The five round-5 review findings were reproduced at the exact reviewed head `e6e31c40`: seven independent component witnesses failed before the fix and passed afterwards. Six deliberate fix reversions each fail their corresponding regression.

On 2026-10-13 the branch was synchronized with upstream main `6373fc4e` in signed merge commit `e1b302e4`. The only textual conflict was the transcript bundle budget; the upstream Excel preview assertions and all round-5 fixes are retained. The transcript JS remainder measures 1,332,856 UTF-16 units, below the existing PR ceiling of 1,336,000. No additional budget increase was needed.

Frozen-lockfile installation, the complete workspace build and CLI bundle, Web Shell TypeScript, related ESLint, and the normal staged-file Prettier/ESLint commit hook pass. The six focused rendering/diff suites pass 426 tests, and the build-artifact suite passes all 30 tests.

The full Web Shell unit run reports 11,520 passed, 83 failed, and three unhandled errors. Failures were confined to the session-provider suite (82) and the settings-route development-server test (one, default 5-second timeout). A separate run of those exact files at the default timeout passes all 420 session-provider tests and 20 of the 21 settings-route tests. A further settings-file run with a command-line 15-second ceiling passes all 21 tests; no repository timeout configuration was changed. The session-provider source, its tests and the settings test are identical to upstream main. An exact-main runtime failure is not claimed, and the complete default-timeout suite is not reported green. Whole-workspace tests and live daemon/model/native Desktop E2E were not run in this synchronization.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| Windows | Actual React/CodeMirror jsdom regressions, package build and static checks; full unit result disclosed above |
| macOS | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Awaiting upstream CI |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node.js 24.20.0, pnpm workspace dependencies and Vitest/jsdom. The workspace CLI was built and bundled during frozen-lockfile installation. No live daemon, live model or native Desktop E2E is claimed.

## Risk & Scope

Compact whole-file previews omit distant unchanged lines; oversized input yields an explicit omitted notice. Invisible characters are represented visibly, so displayed escapes differ from the underlying bytes. Already escaped adapter text stays literal because its original character provenance is unavailable. No permission protocol, tool execution or core-package changes; no dependency changes beyond upstream main synchronization. The current-head CI requires maintainer authorization.

AI assistance: implemented and verified with AI coding assistants, including OpenAI Codex.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13766
